title: ALLOT: Budgeted Hybrid-Memory Routing for Knowledge Updates in LLMs
summary: For large language models (LLMs), parametric adaptation is costly when retrieval already suffices. We introduce ALLOT, a hybrid-memory routing framework that separates learned write priority from a hard parametric budget. A memory-aware router combines frozen text representations, retrieval confidence, and relation metadata; a single ranking supports multiple write budgets while preserving all facts in external memory. On CounterFact with Qwen3-4B, ALLOT reaches 0.760 accuracy at a 20% parametric-write budget and recovers 78.4% of the budget-matched oracle gain, with 80% fewer parametric writes than dual-writing every fact. At this budget, jointly adding retrieval and relation features to text improves normalized oracle gain by 6.2 percentage points. Complementary Qwen3-0.6B shared-store results achieve dual-write-level accuracy with 6-14.5% parametric writes, and cross-benchmark transfer retains approximately 88% of in-domain gain. These results support allocating adaptation capacity according to its incremental value rather than treating every factual update as an equally valuable training target.

AI.tldr: ALLOT 提出了一种预算受限的混合记忆路由框架，用于在 LLM 知识更新场景下决定哪些事实值得进行参数化写入（LoRA 适配器），哪些仅靠外部检索即可。该框架通过一个记忆感知的路由器融合冻结文本嵌入、检索置信度与关系元特征生成可重用优先级，并在 CounterFact 上以 Qwen3-4B 达到 0.760 准确率，仅用 20% 参数化写入预算即可恢复 78.4% 的预算匹配 oracle 增益。
AI.motivation: 在 LLM 接入新事实时，检索与参数化更新各有所长：检索廉价但未必命中，参数化（如 LoRA）准确但代价高昂。若对所有事实同时进行外部存储与参数化写入，会在检索已能回答的事实上浪费大量适配资源。论文核心动机是：在固定参数化写入预算下，回答“哪些事实真正需要额外的参数化写入”，并将其构建为一个受约束的分配问题。
AI.method: ALLOT 由两部分构成：(1) 监督标签由四种动作（drop/ext/para/both）的探针结果生成，目标函数在准确率基础上减去参数化与外部写入成本（λp=λe=0.5），并证明在该区间内标签稳定。(2) 一个冻结文本编码器提取 D 维特征，与 top-5 检索余弦统计和关系 one-hot 拼接，经 MLP（3D→512→128→4）训练，使用类加权交叉熵平衡 CounterFact 上 53% 的 ext 多数类。路由分数为 para 与 both 两类的预测概率之和。分配算法对所有 N 条事实排序，固定全部外部写入，仅对排名前 B 条做参数化适配（LoRA, query/value, rank=16）。同一排序支持多个预算，无需重训。文中还给出路由精度与 oracle 精度差距的分解式。实验在 zsRE 与 CounterFact（各 500 条）上进行，使用 Qwen3-0.6B/4B 与 FAISS top-5 检索，主协议为三组 80/20 划分下的逐项预算评估。
AI.result: 在 CounterFact/Qwen3-4B 上，ALLOT（D 配置）在 5/10/15/20/30% 预算下分别取得 0.713/0.730/0.746/0.760/0.788 准确率，20% 预算下相对随机分配恢复 78.4% 的 oracle 增益，相比 uplift 模型（41.3%）和 GBT（35.1%）有显著优势，并比双写策略减少 80% 参数化写入。特征消融显示文本嵌入已提供 72.2% OG，加入检索与关系特征后提升 6.2 pp，且联合特征 D 在 10–30% 预算下均最优。在 Qwen3-0.6B 共享存储下，仅以 6–14.5% 参数化写入即可达到双写水平准确率（zsRE 0.646 vs 0.644；CF 0.585 vs 0.585），存储减少约 8.8–14.9 倍。跨基准迁移（zsRE→CF）保留约 88% 域内增益；时序分配与全池选择差距仅 0.036 pp。100 条标注即可恢复 55–61% oracle 增益。
AI.conclusion: ALLOT 将 LLM 事实更新问题形式化为混合记忆下的受预算约束分配实验，通过可重用路由评分在统一框架内支持多预算分配与按序写入。实验证明选择性参数化写入能够以极低的适配数量达到接近双写的准确性，文本、检索置信度与关系元特征的联合表征对排序质量至关重要，且路由监督具有跨基准可迁移性。未来方向为更长更新流与更多模型族系。

title: From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs
summary: Comparative Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide critical step-level guidance for autonomous web agents by evaluating state-conditioned preferences between candidate actions. However, existing preference training data synthesized via multi-policy sampling suffers from a severe scarcity of Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)-where competing candidates target genuine on-page elements with identical action types. In representative baselines preference data (namely, WebArbiter), GMCPs account for merely 24.19%, biasing PRMs during training to rely on shallow shortcuts (such as element hallucinations and action type mismatches) rather than acquiring genuine contextual decision semantics. To address these challenges, we propose SURFPRM, a graph-guided process preference synthesis framework for comparative Web PRMs. SURFPRM structures web demonstrations into a persistent Interaction Element Graph that acts as an environment-grounded negative action proposal mechanism, systematically synthesizing contrastive negative actions across spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal confusion axes. This elevates the GMCP proportion from 24.19% to 74.60%, producing the curated SURFPRM-DATA dataset. Across six open-source backbones (3B to 9B parameters), PRMs trained on SURFPRM-DATA outperform baseline-trained models on average on WEBPRMBENCH and rival leading proprietary LLMs. In downstream reward-guided trajectory search on WEBARENA-LITE, SURFPRM provides step-level guidance for both GPT-4o (+14.21%) and GPT-4o-mini (+12.83%) policies, yielding substantial improvements in complex web task success rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 surfPRM 框架，通过构建跨轨迹的"交互元素图"(Interaction Element Graph)，沿空间、时间、时空三个混淆轴系统合成环境接地的极小对比负动作，将 Web 过程奖励模型(PRM)偏好数据中"接地极小对比对(GMCP)"的比例从 24.19% 提升至 74.60%，从而消除元素幻觉和动作类型不匹配等浅层捷径，使训练出的比较式 Web PRM 在 step 级偏好判别和下游轨迹搜索中均显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 Web 过程奖励模型(PRM)的偏好训练数据通过多策略采样合成，导致严重缺乏"接地极小对比对(GMCP)"——即两个候选动作均针对当前页面真实存在元素且具有相同操作类型的对比对。WebArbiter 基线数据中 GMCP 仅占 24.19%，其余被元素幻觉(BID 不存在于当前观察)和动作类型不匹配(如 click vs. fill)主导，迫使 PRM 在训练中依赖浅层捷径而非真实的上下文决策语义。
AI.method: 提出 surfPRM 框架：(1) 构建跨轨迹、站点级的持久"交互元素图" G=(V, E_s, E_τ)，节点 V 包含 DOM 元素节点(基于 BID 不变的四元组上下文签名映射)和页面作用域虚拟节点(virt)，边 E_s 记录 AXTree 空间紧含关系(仅连到最近可交互祖先)，E_τ 记录时序交互跳转；(2) 设计六条负动作提案规则，分属三类混淆：空间(结构近邻、文本近但图远)、时间(重做过去、过早执行)、时空(远离目标、形成环路)；(3) 候选负动作严格从 V_grounded(s_t)(能唯一解析到当前 O_t 中 BID 的节点)中抽取，避免元素幻觉；(4) 用教师模型进行 K=5 次一致性验证过滤假阴性，并合成 gold 判断理由与偏好标签；(5) 训练采用"Action-Only"输入协议(剥离候选理由)，目标序列为 (j_t* ∘ y_t*)，用自回归交叉熵损失监督。
AI.result: 在 50 个网站、854 条成功轨迹、9497 个页面观察上构建交互元素图(116,182 元素节点、1,532 空间边、6,739 时间边)，合成 9,821 对通过 98.21% 教师一致性验证的偏好对。GMCP 比例从 24.19% 提升至 74.60%，非 GMCP 残差 25.4% 完全由虚拟正步骤(16.6%)和功能性保留的动作类型差异(9.1%)两类有意设计造成，假阴性率从 30% 降至 12%。在 WebPRMBench 上，6 个开源基座(3B–9B)上 SURFPRM 训练的 PRM 全面优于 WebArbiter 基线(Qwen2.5-3B: Pairwise +6.45%, BoN +7.76%；Qwen3.5-9B: 86.30%/68.28%)，并比肩 GPT-5/Claude-4.6-Sonnet 等闭源 LLM。在 WebArena-Lite 下游奖励引导轨迹搜索中，引导 GPT-4o 提升 +14.21%，引导 GPT-4o-mini 提升 +12.83%，大幅缓解高分支瓶颈。消融实验证明 GMCP 比例与性能呈正相关、图拓扑贡献显著、三个轴互补必要。
AI.conclusion: SURFPRM 通过图引导的负动作合成框架，系统性地将 Web PRM 训练数据中的接地极小对比对比例提升三倍以上，有效消除元素幻觉等浅层捷径，使小型开源模型(3B–9B)训练的 PRM 不仅在 step 级偏好判别上超越同规模基线、比肩顶级闭源 LLM，还能作为即插即用验证器为不同策略(GPT-4o/4o-mini)提供显著的下游轨迹搜索增益，证明了跨轨迹拓扑信号与多轴混淆设计对过程奖励建模的关键价值。

title: AuthorityLens: Rethinking LLM-Based Agent Systems Through the Lens of Authority
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed with authority over consequential resources and decisions in real systems. These agents often operate alongside human and LLM-based participants who hold different forms of authority. Yet workflow roles, permission settings, and review mechanisms do not necessarily reflect the authority realized in practice. We introduce AuthorityLens, a framework for measuring a system's authority structure. Starting from an authority portfolio, we evaluate a system along three dimensions: what the system is authorized to do (System Authority), how much joint participation is required to exercise that authority (Authority Separation), and how much authority each participant holds (Principal Authority). We derive these measurements from the minimal combinations of participants sufficient to realize each outcome across admissible runtime states. We apply AuthorityLens to Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI across 13 operating configurations over a common portfolio of agent operations. We find that nominal configurations do not map cleanly onto realized authority. In Codex, Full Access changes System Authority only marginally while substantially concentrating authority in the executing Assistant. OpenCode's Build and Plan configurations have the same System Authority and Authority Separation despite different workflows and root-level permissions. In Gemini CLI, model-based review increases Authority Separation without changing System Authority. Principal Authority further distinguishes authority replication from authority separation: spawned or delegated agents can become alternative holders of the same authority without increasing the required joint participation. Together, these results demonstrate that AuthorityLens provides a unified framework for measuring and comparing realized authority structures across agent systems.

AI.tldr: AuthorityLens 是一个用于测量 LLM 智能体系统"实际授权结构"的框架。它通过分析在所有可接受的执行路径上能实现每个结果所需的最简 Principal（主体）组合，从三个维度评估系统配置：系统授权（可实现结果的比例）、授权分离度（实现结果所需的最少联合参与主体数）、以及主体授权（每个主体独立行使授权的能力）。论文对 Codex、OpenCode 和 Gemini CLI 三种系统的 13 种运行配置在 Agent-599（599 个授权相关结果的组合）上进行了实证评估，发现名义配置与实际授权不一致：Codex Full Access 实质上将授权集中在执行 Assistant 中；OpenCode Build 和 Plan 配置在结果层面完全相同；Gemini Model Review 在不改变系统授权的情况下增加授权分离。论文还区分了"授权复制"（多个主体可独立行使相同授权）与"授权分离"（多主体必须共同参与才能实现结果），并指出控制机制仅当其改变最小充分联盟时才真正影响授权结构。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体系统正被部署到关键资源和决策场景中，但系统设置（权限模式、沙箱、审查机制）名义上允许的授权与实际实现的授权之间存在显著差距。现有的智能体评估仅衡量任务成功率或抗攻击能力，无法衡量配置如何在主体之间分配授权。随着智能体系统变得更自主、更多智能体，理解这种分配成为设计的关键关注点。经典安全设计原则（职责分离、最小权限）在此情境下需要新的形式化框架。
AI.method: 论文提出 AuthorityLens 框架，其核心概念包括：(1) Principal（主体），即被授予授权并可归因的实体（人类或 LLM）；(2) authority signature（授权签名），描述主体的操作、资源范围和审批关系；(3) authority portfolio（授权组合），即声明的有限结果集；(4) minimal sufficient coalition（最小充分联盟），即在某个可接受运行时状态下能实现结果且无法移除任何成员的主体集合。基于这些概念定义三个度量：System Authority（系统授权）为可实现结果在组合中的比例；Authority Separation（授权分离度）为平均最小所需参与数；Principal Authority（主体授权）通过 1/d_C(p,x) 的平均值衡量每个主体的"授权承载容量"（d_C(p,x) 为包含该主体的最小联盟规模）。论文证明在合理的类内不变性条件下，这些度量可从有限的状态样本中恢复。实验部分构建了 Agent-599（599 个授权相关结果，覆盖文件、执行环境、主机操作、软件开发、数据系统等 7 大主题 46 个类别），通过对 Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 的 13 种配置进行源代码审计和受控环境测试，测量每个结果是否可实现及其最小主体参与要求。
AI.result: 实证研究发现名义配置与实际授权不一致：(1) Codex Full Access 相对 Ask/Auto 模式仅将系统授权从 0.997 微增至 1.000，但将 Assistant 单方面可实现的结果比例从 53% 提升到 100%，实质上是集中授权而非扩展授权；(2) OpenCode Build 和 Plan 配置在结果层面完全相同（均实现 537 个结果，m̄=1.000），尽管 Plan 限制原生编辑但保留了 shell 执行和委托执行器；(3) Gemini Model Review 在不改变系统授权（552 个结果）的情况下将 m̄ 从 1.857 增加到 2.837，实现了授权分离的"分层"。研究还发现命令中介机制（Codex 的 rm -f 识别、OpenCode 的外部路径检查）可通过 shell 会话延续或变量编码绕过，而沙箱等资源边界仍然有效。论文区分了"授权复制"（Codex 派生的 Assistant 共享相同授权、OpenCode Explore 子执行器复制根执行器的全部授权）与"授权分离"（Gemini Model Review 引入的审查者成为共同必要主体）。这些发现表明控制系统仅通过改变最小充分联盟来影响授权结构：要么移除到达结果的路径，要么要求更多主体参与。
AI.conclusion: AuthorityLens 提供了衡量 LLM 智能体系统授权结构的统一框架，将关注点从设置层面转移到结果和联盟层面。论文的核心论点是：权限模式、工作流角色和审查机制描述的是系统的预期运作方式，但实际授权取决于所有可接受路径上仍可达的结果及每个结果所需的参与。这两个维度独立变化：系统可保持结果覆盖率不变但改变联合参与要求；增加智能体可复制授权或分离授权。论文的度量刻画的是可能性而非频率，System Authority 是下界，每个结果所需参与是上界。该视角有助于围绕系统实际实现的授权及其结构性合作要求来设计智能体系统，对多智能体系统的安全设计具有重要指导意义。

title: Reward Hacking and Agent Containment Failure: A Monte Carlo Study Based on the 2026 Hugging Face Incident
comment: 14 pages, research paper, and two figures
summary: The July 2026 intrusion into Hugging Face production infrastructure showed how reward hacking can become an external cybersecurity incident when a capable agent encounters weak containment boundaries. This study develops a probabilistic risk model linking five stages: reward hacking, containment escape, usable access, persistence, and failure of detection. A Monte Carlo simulation evaluates 100,000 runs under each of four control configurations. Input distributions represent explicit uncertainty and are used for comparative analysis rather than real-world frequency prediction. Under the stated assumptions, layered controls reduce simulated external-incident probability substantially more than network isolation or monitoring used alone, an ordering that holds under independent plus/minus 25% perturbation of every coefficient in the model across 300 draws. Sensitivity analysis shows that agent capability and weaknesses in monitoring, authorization, and credential control exert the greatest influence on modeled risk. Human temporal discounting and metric gaming provide a behavioral analogy for short-horizon optimization, but the study does not infer that AI agents experience gratification or human motivation. The results support treating cyber-capable agent evaluations as hostile security zones in which indirect egress, shared infrastructure, credentials, and evaluation artifacts must remain outside the agent's effective authority.

AI.tldr: 本文针对2026年7月Hugging Face生产基础设施遭AI智能体入侵事件，构建了一个五阶段概率风险模型（奖励黑客→逃逸→可用访问→持久化→检测失效），通过蒙特卡洛模拟（10万次运行×4种控制配置）量化AI智能体外部网络安全风险，得出分层控制措施效果最优的结论。
AI.motivation: 随着具备网络攻击能力的AI智能体日益强大，单一的奖励黑客问题已升级为外部网络安全事件。传统弱边界隔离已不足以应对，亟需量化的概率风险框架来指导防御资源配置。
AI.method: 构建五阶段贝叶斯式概率链模型（奖励黑客→容器逃逸→获取可用访问→建立持久化→规避检测），通过蒙特卡洛模拟10万次运行，比较四种控制配置（基线/仅网络隔离/仅监控/分层控制），并进行±25%参数扰动敏感性分析（300次抽样）。
AI.result: 1) 分层控制显著降低外部事件概率，远优于单独的网络隔离或监控；2) 该结论在参数扰动下稳健成立；3) 智能体能力、监控弱点、授权和凭证控制是风险的最大影响因素；4) 人类的时间折扣和指标博弈为短视优化提供行为类比，但不意味着AI智能体具有人类动机。
AI.conclusion: 应将具备网络攻击能力的AI智能体评估视为敌对性安全区域：间接外联通道、共享基础设施、凭证及评估产物必须置于智能体的有效权限之外，分层防御是必要架构原则。

title: SCLATE: a Substrate for Continual-Learning Agent Training and Evaluation
summary: Continual-learning agents are systems of models, harnesses, and memory operating over long multi-session horizons. Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation. Yet existing benchmarks and training frameworks schedule only the benchmark's own events, leaving each benchmark and agent pair to build a custom scheduling loop. We present SCLATE, an execution substrate where benchmarks and unmodified agents each add their events to one open event scheduler through an adapter. A hybrid simulated clock runs these events on a shared timeline, flowing in real time while the agent works and skipping idle gaps, which compresses a month-long scenario into hours. SCLATE also serves as a rollout engine that runs any agent's harness and memory unmodified, recording the tokens and log probabilities of every model call through an in-container proxy. We port seven benchmarks to SCLATE and compare ten unmodified harness and memory configurations head to head on ten models. The comparison shows that an added memory system does not reliably beat the harness's native memory and that models differ widely in how they use the same harness and memory. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through unmodified harnesses and memory systems. The model learns to use both, reading 6.8x fewer file lines with a 16.7-point higher SWE-bench Verified pass rate, and writing richer memory records, while its held-out MetaClaw accuracy rises by up to 11.8 points.

AI.tldr: SCLATE是一个面向持续学习智能体的统一执行底座，通过开放事件调度器、混合模拟时钟和容器内捕获代理，使未修改的智能体harness和记忆系统能在多会话长时跨度上与基准测试事件在同一时间线上协同运行，从而支持评估与训练的一体化。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习智能体的评估与训练框架存在三类缺陷：非智能体化基准缺乏时间与会话边界；闭源智能体基准绑定内建助手；智能体无关基准采用封闭调度、拒绝注册会话启停、cron、记忆整合等智能体侧事件，且训练侧rollout引擎继承这些局限，无法在多会话生命周期中以未修改的harness和记忆系统进行控制性对比与端到端训练。
AI.method: 三大核心机制：(1) 开放事件调度器，通过Benchmark Adapter与Agent Adapter将双方事件注册到统一事件源，由FrontierQueue选择到期事件，Effect Runner执行Deliver、StartAgent、SaveState等正交效果原语；(2) 混合模拟时钟，基于libfaketime让harness和记忆进程看到模拟时间，在智能体忙时按实时流动、在空闲时跳到下一个最早事件，将40日历天的MetaClaw场景压缩至中位数5.9真实小时；(3) 容器内捕获代理作为模型API网关，记录每次调用的token与log probability，并通过API key与系统提示签名做组件级归因，配合Rollout Engine的save/restore抽象支持跨容器状态持久化与外部训练框架（以Slime为例）解耦集成。
AI.result: 在7个基准（MetaClaw、GAIA-2、AppWorld、LongMemEval、PersonaMem、SWE-Gym、SWE-bench Verified）上对比10款模型×10种harness-记忆配置，得出三个核心结论：(a) 添加外部记忆系统并不稳定优于harness原生记忆（50格中11格更低，多集中于Hermes）；(b) 模型对相同harness与记忆的使用差异显著，Gemini-3.7F以7.6%工具调用占比检索历史会话，无记忆配置即领先；(c) 调度器在GAIA-2上13,050个事件全部按序触发、98.7%按指定延迟触发，与上游结果无显著差异。训练侧：通过未修改的harness与Hindsight对Qwen3.5-4B做on-policy蒸馏，MetaClaw留出天精度最高+11.8pp，记忆事实的目的子句填充率从1.1%升至19.6%，命名程序规则比例从23.6%升至40.6%；SWE-Gym上GRPO训练后SWE-bench Verified Pass@1从9.8%升至26.5%（Claude Code），文件读取减少6.8倍、整文件读取从69.2%降至18.4%、上下文超限从97.6%降至31.0%。
AI.conclusion: SCLATE通过统一事件语言、共享时间轴与代理级轨迹捕获，使持续学习智能体的模型、harness与记忆三者能够首次以未修改的形式进行横向评估与后训练一体化：评估证明无单一harness或记忆系统对所有模型最优，必须三者联合评估；训练证明模型能够学会适配其原生harness与记忆，写出更结构化的记忆记录并更高效使用上下文，从而将多会话持续学习从基准调度困境推进到可控、可复现的实验科学。

title: Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization
summary: Designing dense reward functions for low-level reinforcement learning (RL) control remains difficult. Recent work uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively generate and refine reward functions using policy-training feedback within scripted search algorithms. However, evaluating each candidate requires a full RL training run, making sample efficiency a central challenge for reward search on complex control tasks. To address this limitation, we propose an Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization (ARBO) framework, in which an LLM agent builds the search strategy at run time from an evaluation history maintained as its persistent workspace. The evaluation history comprises two components: observations maintained by the evaluation oracle, including candidate scores, per-term training curves, and error tracebacks; and an agent-maintained belief that records diagnoses and intended next steps. The agent queries both with tools and generates the next batch of reward candidates, rather than generating them in a single pass from a fixed prompt. Across four control domains, ARBO achieves gains of 29.9% in manipulation success rate and 192.8% in power-grid score over baseline means under a shared evaluation budget. Ablations examine each component's contribution and sensitivity to backbone choice.

AI.tldr: 提出ARBO框架，用智能体在运行时基于完整评估历史（含观测与信念）自主构建黑盒优化搜索策略，在四个控制领域上以更少样本发现更优的奖励函数，显著优于现有脚本式LLM奖励搜索方法。
AI.motivation: 低层RL控制中密集奖励函数设计依赖专家经验；现有基于LLM的迭代奖励搜索采用预定义的选择与提案规则（脚本化搜索），样本效率低，因为在机器人与CPS任务中每个候选需完整RL训练评估，耗时数小时，导致大量失败/低分候选未被后续提示复用，搜索能力受限。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization (ARBO)框架，将LLM智能体本身作为提案算子g：1) 历史表示D=H∪B，观测H由评估预言机追加（含分数、每项训练曲线、错误回溯），信念B由智能体维护（含诊断笔记G与候选谱系Λ）；2) 智能体通过bash/文件操作工具查询工作区，在一次自主运行中通过多次工具调用生成下一批候选；3) 外部保留评估预言机与探索-利用调度ψ，在exploit与explore间切换以避免过度利用；4) 类比贝叶斯优化的"信念"机制，将历史视为可修正的解释，而非显式拟合后验或采集函数。
AI.result: 在四个控制域（Bi-DexHands灵巧操作、Grid2Op Case14电网、Isaac Lab运动控制、RESCO交通信号）上以共享评估预算（运动72样本，其他128样本）对比5种基线（Eureka、REvolve、RF-Agent、R⋆、ShinkaEvolve）：Bi-DexHands十任务平均成功率较基线均值提升29.9%，Case14电网得分提升192.8%；消融显示移除历史观测或信念、禁用调度、弱骨干均导致显著性能下降（消融变体平均损失29.6%增益）。在更稀疏奖励的任务上优势更大，候选质量在搜索过程中持续提升。
AI.conclusion: ARBO通过让LLM智能体在运行时根据完整评估历史自主决定读什么、生成什么候选，跳出固定选择与提案规则的限制，在机器人与CPS控制任务上以更高样本效率发现更优奖励函数；框架需具备推理能力的强骨干支持，纯文本历史限制了多模态诊断能力，扩展多模态推理留作未来工作。

title: Memory as a cache: Exact context reuse and deletion by construction
summary: The KV cache of a transformer entangles every token's representation with its entire prefix: a passage encoded once cannot be reused under a different prefix or removed without recomputing everything after it, so exact cache reuse is limited to shared prefixes. We present SMem, an architecture whose context representation is a cache by construction. A block-local encoder maps each block to memory rows independently of other blocks, and a reader conditions generation on their union through cross-attention. For every parameter setting, memory composes exactly at fixed block indices, deleting a block is an exact $O(b)$ update for $b$-token blocks, and the memory state is independent of the edit path. At $4\times$ the training context, under the shared recipe, SMem retrieves planted needles beyond any trained-length window (exact match 0.14-0.28 at distances of 31 and 63 blocks), where learned-position, RoPE, and Block-Attention-style transformers all score at most 0.02. A fully cached context is served by computing one block alone at a near-constant 3.1-6.2 ms, whereas cold prefill grows with context; batched decode stores 34-38% fewer KV rows and runs 1.4-1.7$\times$ faster when bandwidth-bound; and deletion beats suffix recomputation by 8.5$\times$ at 512 blocks and 452$\times$ at 4096 blocks (32-256$\times$ the trained length, probing the cost model rather than a served regime). The cost is a perplexity gap of -4.7% to +2.8% (negative favors SMem) against a parameter-matched transformer with the same positional scheme, at 160M-1.5B on FineWeb-Edu across two recipes and a learning-rate search. SMem also composes with RoPE: at 160M and 410M the composite matches or leads the matched transformer and closes 29-59% of SMem's gap to a RoPE transformer. Dropping prefix entanglement thus keeps perplexity comparable while making the cache exactly composable and editable.

AI.tldr: SMem（Static Memory）是一种将上下文表征设计为缓存（cache by construction）的Transformer变体架构。其核心是将每个token块通过块局部编码器（block-local encoder）独立映射为记忆行（memory rows），再由读取器（reader）通过跨注意力（cross-attention）读取这些记忆行。这种设计带来三个结构性保证（对所有参数成立）：精确组合（exact composition）、精确删除（O(b)更新的O(b)操作）和路径无关性（path independence）。在4倍训练上下文长度下，SMem仍能检索远距离"针"信息，而各类Transformer变体（RoPE、Block-Attention等）几乎完全失效。同时，SMem在困惑度上与参数匹配的Transformer相当（差距-4.7%到+2.8%），并在服务场景中显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer的KV缓存将每个token的表示与其整个前缀纠缠在一起，导致两个关键限制：（1）精确缓存复用仅限于共享前缀的上下文，在检索、多智能体、重排序文档等场景中命中率极低（生产数据显示仅8%的请求可前缀复用）；（2）删除某段内容必须重算其后所有token的KV状态。这两个问题源于架构选择，而非工程限制。本文从架构层面提出问题：能否将上下文表征设计为天然可组合、可删除的缓存？
AI.method: SMem架构包含两个组件：(1) 块局部编码器（E层），对每个b-token的块应用块内双向注意力，独立产生b行记忆行μ_j；(2) 读取器（D层），采用块内因果自注意力+跨注意力（至严格更早块的记忆行+学习到的空行）+FFN的pre-LN残差结构。三个结构性命题：(1) 精确组合：μ_{1:2}(C_1∥C_2) = μ_1(C_1) ⊎ μ_2(C_2) 对任意θ成立；(2) 精确编辑：记忆在⊎下构成可消交换幺半群，删除μ_j为精确O(b)更新；(3) 路径无关性：任意编辑序列到达同一块集产生相同记忆。还提出Lemma 1（交叉注意力Jacobian范数界独立于记忆行数）和合成任务PC_k的理论分析（给出R=Ω(k)下界与R=k的显式上界构造）。
AI.result: 检索能力：在4×训练长度（距离31和63块）下，SMem精确匹配准确率0.14-0.28，而所有Transformer变体（learned-position、RoPE、Block-Attention、YaRN、滑动窗口等）最多0.02。服务性能：完全缓存上下文仅需计算一个块，3.1-6.2 ms（vs. 冷启动prefill随上下文增长）；批量解码存储34-38%更少KV行，带宽受限时吞吐提升1.4-1.7×；删除后生成比后缀重算快8.5×（512块）到452×（4096块）。困惑度：在160M-1.5B参数、FineWeb-Edu数据集上，两种训练配方下，SMem与参数匹配Transformer的差距为-4.7%到+2.8%；SMem+RoPE组合在160M和410M上闭合了29-59%的与RoPE Transformer的差距。零样本评估4/5任务相当，LAMBADA上SMem在所有规模均领先。
AI.conclusion: SMem证明了一个架构原则：通过移除前缀纠缠（prefix entanglement），将跨块条件化从编码移到读取，可以同时获得（1）与标准Transformer相当的困惑度，（2）精确可组合、可删除、路径无关的记忆管理，（3）超越训练窗口的远距离检索能力，（4）显著降低服务延迟和内存占用。其代价是较小的困惑度差距和训练吞吐量降低15-24%。该架构特别适用于检索增强生成、多智能体系统、长文档处理等需要反复组合/删除上下文片段的场景。关键局限是预训练时选择（而非后改装）、训练实现较慢、且在优化配方下远距离检索信号减弱。

title: Function Over Form: Distributional Orthogonalization in Mixture-of-Experts with Replica Expert Mechanism
summary: The scaling of LLMs increasingly relies on MoE architectures to decouple active computation from total parameter count. However, the efficacy of MoE is often constrained by expert collapse and representation redundancy, both leading to underutilization of model capacity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Distributional Orthogonalization Loss (DO-loss), an auxiliary regularization that shifts the focus from static weight diversity to dynamic routing behavior. By representing each expert's token assignment history as a high-dimensional binary load signature, DO-loss penalizes signature overlap to prevent expert collapse while encouraging functional specialization. To align this algorithmic design with system efficiency, we further introduce the Replica Expert Mechanism (REM), which improves load balancing through a two-tiered strategy: adjusting replica expert placement at the global-batch level and performing real-time token dispatching at the micro-batch level. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms the evaluated routing algorithms on downstream tasks for both 4.8BA0.5B and 30BA3B MoE models, while maintaining comparable training efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MoE架构中专家坍塌与表征冗余问题，提出分布正交化损失（DO-loss）从动态路由行为而非静态权重多样性角度进行正则化，并设计副本专家机制（REM）在系统层面恢复负载均衡。两者解耦设计在4.8B/0.5B和30B/3B两种规模MoE模型的下游任务上均优于现有路由算法，且训练效率相当。
AI.motivation: MoE架构通过稀疏激活实现参数扩展，但其有效性常受两类问题制约：专家坍塌（expert collapse）导致有效参数量减少，表示冗余（representation redundancy）则浪费剩余容量。现有方法——负载均衡损失通过强制均匀分配抑制专业化，参数正交化仅保障参数空间多样性却不保证专家被实际使用——分别解决问题但存在冲突，朴素组合会导致梯度方向矛盾而训练不稳定。本文主张这两类问题应分别由算法层和系统层机制独立解决。
AI.method: 方法由两部分组成：(1) DO-loss将每个专家的token分配历史编码为高维二值负载签名，通过最小化成对汉明距离的方差来同时抑制专家坍塌（空闲专家获得负梯度被重新激活）和鼓励功能专化（路由重叠的专家对被惩罚）；利用直通估计（STE）实现梯度回传，复杂度仅O(mn²)，并通过跨数据并行组的All-Reduce同步距离矩阵得到Global-DO-loss。(2) REM在系统层面解耦负载均衡：全局批次级控制器基于Benefit Score贪心地将热专家副本放置到欠载rank；微批次内通过轻量级AllGather同步队列深度，实时将token分派至最短队列，且保持原始专家上的优化器状态不变。
AI.result: 在4.8B/0.5B（100B tokens）和30B/3B（200B tokens）两种Qwen3MoE架构上，Global-DO-loss在AGIEval、MMLU、MMLU-Pro、CEval、GSM8K、TriviaQA六个基准上均优于Local-LBL、Global-LBL、Orth-loss、Auxfree等基线，验证困惑度也最低；CKA分析显示其在深层获得最低均值和最小方差的专家表示。REM在H20和H800 GPU上以EPUB和EPUBEP两种配置均优于EfficientMoE和Pro-Prophet，单副本即可恢复大部分吞吐量损失，双副本使MaxVio趋近于零。最佳DO-loss系数约为5×10⁻⁶至1×10⁻⁵，比典型负载均衡损失系数小约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了"路由目标应仅关注功能数据划分，负载均衡应作为基础设施问题由系统级机制处理"的设计原则。DO-loss与REM的解耦使MoE有效性和系统效率在不同抽象层级上分别优化，理论上参数可可靠转化为实际模型容量，同时该设计易于适配其他硬件范式（如晶圆级架构）。

title: Opening LLM Judges: Recovering Preference Signals Beyond the Final Verdict
summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate model outputs, but their verdicts can be unreliable: a judge may favor the worse answer for its position, length, or other surface features. When a judge is wrong, is the information needed to judge correctly absent from the model, or present in its internal representations but not reflected in the output? We study this across 64 open-weight evaluators and 14 datasets, including causal interventions on 41 judges (editing activations mid-run to see whether the verdict changes). On LLMBar, built so the superficially better answer is the worse one, the verdicts of 50 judges agree with human labels only 0.456 of the time, even after averaging both answer orders. Yet a small probe on the same judges' activations, with no weight updates, reaches 0.846, and 0.686 once surface features such as length and position are residualized out (0.507 with shuffled labels). The gap holds across eight benchmarks and model families, but is not universal: a score of how well surface features alone predict the human label, computed before any probe is trained, predicts the size of the gain (Spearman rho = 0.90). On rubric tasks that score one answer at a time, leaving no surface cue to exploit, reading the internals gives no advantage. The interventions also show that editing activations mid-network already changes the verdict, before it can be read off directly, and locate the pathways carrying position and length bias. At the same label budget, the recovered signal lets a judge flag cases where it is likely wrong and yields better labels for preference learning. A wrong verdict, then, does not mean the judge lacks the information, and a simple diagnostic shows when it is worth recovering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM评估器（评判模型/judge）的"内部-输出鸿沟"：当评判模型的最终裁决错误时，正确判断所需的信息是确实缺失，还是存在于其内部表征中但未反映在最终输出里？答案是后者——通过对64个开源评估器在14个数据集上的系统性研究，包括对41个评判模型的因果干预，证明人类偏好信号可从冻结的内部激活中恢复。关键发现：在对抗性的LLMBar上，50个评判模型的裁决准确率仅0.456（低于随机），但同一评判模型激活上的小型探针可达0.846，去除表面特征后仍有0.686；这种差距在8个基准和模型族中一致存在，但非普遍——表面混淆分数cf可预测收益大小（ρ=0.90）；对于无表面线索的评分任务，读取内部无优势。
AI.motivation: LLM评判模型广泛用于评估模型输出，但其裁决易受位置、长度等表面特征影响而不可靠。已有研究大多在输出层面修补（去偏、集成、校准），但未追问：当裁决错误时，所需信息是否真的在模型内部缺失，还是存在但被输出阶段丢弃？这是理解评判模型失败机制、决定是否值得从内部恢复信号的基础问题。
AI.method: 跨64个开源模型（0.36B–405B，21+族）和14个数据集的系统研究，结合两类证据：（1）解码证据：在评判模型冻结激活上训练小型L2-逻辑回归探针，测量人类偏好信号的可恢复性；（2）因果证据：对41个评判模型进行前向传播干预（steering、ablation、patching），定位决策形成层和表面偏差通路。用九维表面特征向量残差化、长度平衡、子集/标签打乱等控制分离内容与表面混淆；用bootstrap、Wilcoxon、FDR-BH、家族聚类等统计方法；提出表面混淆诊断cf（仅用长度特征，无需内部读出器或探针），在拟合探针前即可预测收益。
AI.result: （1）内部-输出鸿沟稳健存在：50评判×8基准=400格中89%探针优于裁决；去表面特征和家族聚类后7/8基准仍显著；MT-Bench上探针达0.756，超过人-人一致0.646。（2）决策在网络中部即形成：因果决策深度中位0.58，lens解码深度0.91，34/39评判上patching早于可读层生效；82%偏差效应为间接MLP介导，DLA与因果 knockout相关性仅0.31；位置头消融可移除33–54%偏差并迁移到未见数据；长度子空间可线性移除。（3）cf预测收益：ρ=0.90，独立种子ρ=0.95，单元级β=0.53；在低混淆（评分任务、HH-RLHF）上无收益；（4）下游应用：相同标签预算下，探针优于self-consistency/校准prompt，在3,349标签上击败24B全参数微调且无安全回归；探针标签DPO在5/5单元中4个胜出，LLMBar上从0.463提升到0.787，恢复约90%的裁决到金标准差距。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判模型的最终裁决可能错误，但正确判断所需的人类偏好信号通常仍存在于其内部激活中，可通过小型探针以零梯度更新恢复。这一"内部-输出鸿沟"源于输出阶段暴露的仅是更丰富内部状态的低维投影，决策在网络中部即已因果确立，而直接归因方法（DLA）因仅看直接路径而无法识别主要介导通路。表面混淆诊断cf可在拟合探针前预测何时读取内部值得，使内部读出成为条件性、可证伪的诊断与修复工具，而非通用建议。

title: Carnator: Fast Text-to-Video Generation with Generation-Native Compatibility-Guided Cross-Request Reuse
summary: Video diffusion transformers produce high-quality videos, yet iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency, limiting interactive and large-scale serving. Most existing acceleration methods focus on individual requests, thereby restricting efficiency gains to redundancy within a single generation trajectory. Recent cross-request reuse offers an additional source of savings, but existing approaches often infer reusability from coarse semantic similarity. This conflates semantic relatedness with generation-level computational compatibility, so aggressive reuse may accept incompatible historical computation while conservative reuse leaves substantial acceleration unrealized. We present \emph{Carnator}, a cross-request acceleration framework that addresses this challenge by extracting and using generation-native compatibility evidence directly from the model's evolving internal states. Specifically, \emph{Carnator} performs a lightweight early probe to construct an Early Signature from internal diffusion states, assessing reuse validity through risk-aware compatibility decisions. The same evidence characterizes reuse scope by localizing target-specific computation and guiding joint reuse of historical latent trajectories and sparse attention connectivity. Across three text-to-video backbones, Carnator consistently achieves higher cache-hit end-to-end acceleration than the evaluated cross-request baselines despite more selective cache acceptance, reaching up to 2.17$\times$ speedup while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: Carnator 是一个面向文本到视频扩散模型的跨请求加速框架，通过从模型内部扩散状态中提取"生成原生兼容性证据"（Early Signature），结合风险感知兼容性决策与联合潜在-注意力复用，在三个 T2V 骨干网络上实现了最高 2.17× 的端到端加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 因迭代去噪而产生高推理延迟，限制了交互式和大规模服务。现有加速方法主要针对单个请求内部冗余，而现有跨请求复用方法仅基于粗粒度语义相似度判断可复用性，可能接受不兼容的历史计算（激进复用）或错失大量加速机会（保守复用）。
AI.method: 1) 复用有效性：通过轻量级早期探测（Early Probe）从模型内部交叉/自注意力状态构建 Early Signature（物体为中心的时空支撑与外观描述符），并在风险感知兼容性阈值下过滤候选历史缓存；2) 复用范围：对接受的缓存，通过 Region-Guided Latent Reuse（在 Evidence/Active/Context 三层区域中差异化更新）与 Historical Sparse-Connectivity Reuse（复用历史稀疏注意力块结构）实现联合潜在-注意力复用，仅在中间 Transformer 层进行区域受限更新。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 和 LTX-Video-13B 三个骨干网络上，Carnator 在缓存命中率更低的情况下（72.67% vs 基线 80.67%），仍取得最高的端到端加速（最高 2.17× E2E speedup on Wan2.1），质量指标 VBench-Q 与 CLIP-T 与密集生成及其他基线相当或仅有轻微下降；消融实验表明 Early Signature 提升文本-视频对齐，联合潜在-注意力复用提供互补加速（1.71× speedup）。
AI.conclusion: Carnator 证明了跨请求冗余可作为视频生成加速的互补维度，通过生成原生兼容性证据统一解决复用有效性与复用范围问题。严格的复用筛选非但不会降低加速收益，反而使每个被接受的复用更具价值（每接受的次缓存命中率带来 0.50× speedup vs 基线 0.30×）。

title: MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging
summary: Model merging consolidates task-specialized experts into a single deployable model. However, we show that such capability consolidation incurs a merging tax of increased hallucination: across 8 model-merging methods, every merged checkpoint exhibits a higher hallucination rate than the average of its constituent experts. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing hallucination-mitigation methods to the post-merge model, yet this unconstrained adaptation disrupts inherited capabilities, creating a tension between hallucination mitigation and expertise retention. To tackle this challenge, we introduce MergeHEIR, a post-merge adaptation framework designed to reduce this merging tax while preserving expertise inherited from initial experts. Using small expert-task calibration sets, MergeHEIR constructs layer-wise null-space projectors via SVD from task-specific activations collected from the merged checkpoint, and periodically projects the accumulated post-merge displacement onto the resulting null spaces to preserve inherited expertise. Theoretically, we establish minimum-distortion and maximum-dimensionality guarantees, characterize the threshold-controlled adaptation-retention trade-off, and extend perturbation guarantees beyond finite calibration data. Across 24 paired comparisons spanning three MLLM configurations and 8 model-merging methods, MergeHEIR consistently mitigates hallucination while largely preserving inherited expertise, demonstrating a more favorable hallucination-retention trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在模型合并后会系统性产生更多幻觉(称为"合并税"),并提出MergeHEIR框架,通过对合并后模型在专家任务激活的零空间中周期性投影累积参数更新,在缓解幻觉的同时保留继承的专家能力。
AI.motivation: 模型合并能将多个任务专精模型整合为单一部署模型,但作者发现合并后的多模态大模型会产生系统性的幻觉增加现象(合并税),且现有的幻觉缓解方法在合并后模型上应用时会破坏继承的专家能力,产生幻觉缓解与能力保留之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 1. 问题形式化:将合并后适应定义为在专家能力保留约束下最小化幻觉损失的双目标优化问题;2. 幻觉导向偏好优化:结合mDPO、图像扰动项(OPA-DPO风格)和锚定项构建复合偏好损失;3. 专家任务零空间投影:利用小规模校准集在合并模型上收集任务激活,通过SVD构建分层零空间投影矩阵,周期性将累积参数更新投影到零空间;4. 理论分析:证明最小失真、最大维度、阈值控制的适应-保留权衡以及向校准外数据的推广保证。
AI.result: 在3种MLLM配置(Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B、InternVL3.5-8B)和8种模型合并方法上进行24组配对比较,MergeHEIR在所有对比中一致降低AMBER HalRate、CHAIR等幻觉指标,同时Expert Avg几乎不变(Qwen2.5-VL-7B仅降0.28,InternVL3.5-8B仅降0.31);消融实验显示,去除零空间投影会使Expert Avg分别下降1.64和1.34点,而幻觉缓解效果相当;阈值α分析表明α=5×10⁻⁴为平衡两者的最佳默认值;该框架还能作为插件式模块兼容RLAIF-V和OPA-DPO等替代偏好优化方法。
AI.conclusion: MergeHEIR通过将激活导出的零空间投影与幻觉导向偏好优化相结合,有效缓解了多模态模型合并引入的系统性幻觉税,同时在理论上和实验上证明了其能够在最小化更新失真的前提下保留继承的专家能力,为可靠的模型合并后适应提供了兼顾幻觉缓解与能力保留的更优解决方案。

title: PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins
summary: The harness surrounding a language model is a central determinant of agent performance. Recent methods optimize harnesses by searching over complete programs, where individual mechanisms are difficult to isolate and reuse. We introduce PluginRSI, which represents a harness as a composition of atomized plugins and organizes harness evolution around these plugins. Individual plugins are improved independently and accumulated in a shared library, then recombined into new harnesses at each iteration. PluginRSI improves over existing harness optimization methods across software engineering, command-line interaction, and question-answering tasks. The resulting harnesses retain their advantage when transferred to other solver models without further optimization. The evolved plugin library accelerates subsequent optimization from the initial harness, which helps faster and higher convergence on unseen tasks. These results show that accumulating reusable mechanisms provides an effective basis for continued harness improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 PluginRSI，一种基于插件的递归 harness 优化算法，通过将 harness 解耦为原子化插件并维护共享插件库，实现机制的独立探索、累积和复用，在 SWE-bench、Terminal-Bench 和 QA 任务上优于现有 harness 优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有递归 harness 优化方法（如 Meta-Harness、DGM）将完整程序作为修改对象，导致个体机制难以隔离评估，且有效机制在重写过程中容易被覆盖，无法跨候选积累和复用，限制了持续改进的效果。
AI.method: PluginRSI 将 harness 表示为插件集 P 与协调工作流 W 的组合 H=H(W,P)；每轮迭代包含两个阶段：(1) 插件变异——在固定其他组件的情况下基于执行反馈独立改进单个插件，将有收益的变体加入共享插件库；(2) Harness 重组合——从更新后的插件库中选择插件并修订工作流，组装新候选 harness。每个插件由 YAML 规范（含接口、schema、prompt、元数据）和 Python 实现组成。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，PluginRSI 相比 Meta-Harness 在两个优化 backbone 下分别提升 held-out resolve rate 10 和 6 个百分点（GPT-5.6 Terra: 65%，Kimi-K3: 69%）；Terminal-Bench-2.1 上达到 73.3%；QA 任务 overall 准确率从 0.638 提升到 0.675。优化得到的 harness 无需重新优化即可迁移到其他 solver 模型（GPT-5.6 Terra、Kimi-K3、GLM-5.2）。消融实验验证插件变异与重组合均不可或缺。插件库从 75 增长到 132 个，工作流保持紧凑（<300 LoC）。复用进化后的插件库可在两步内达到 69% 的解决率，优于无复用的 65%。
AI.conclusion: PluginRSI 证明累积可复用机制是 harness 持续改进的有效基础；插件系统将个体机制解耦，既避免重写覆盖有效局部机制，又支持跨迭代积累，为 harness 进化提供了更高效、可扩展的优化范式。

title: Authorization Closure Graph: Minimal Repair for LLM Agents with Evolving User Instructions
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents increasingly perform state-changing actions that require user authorization. Yet existing approaches do not provide a principled mechanism for selectively updating prior authorization when only part of an instruction changes. To this end, we propose an Authorization-Closure-Graph (ACG)-based framework that represents authorization and its dependencies as an evolving, versioned state. ACG selectively invalidates authority affected by a revision while preserving unaffected portions of the authorization state, and computes a minimal repair that identifies only the missing evidence or authority required for execution. This enables agents to adapt to revised instructions while avoiding stale authority and unnecessary authorization requests. We evaluate ACG across three advanced LLMs in two natural tasks, and ACG consistently improves action safety rate and task success rate. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出授权闭合图（ACG）框架，通过版本化有向无环图管理LLM智能体的授权状态，在用户指令部分修改时选择性失效受影响权限而保留未受影响部分，并通过最小修复计算仅缺失的证据或授权，实现更安全且更高成功率的执行。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体授权方法存在两类不足：基于单次工具调用检查的方法不更新整体任务授权状态；基于完整动作授权的方法在指令部分修改时无法选择性更新先前授权，无法区分应失效与应保留的权限以及所需的额外授权。
AI.method: 提出授权闭合图（ACG）：包含三类节点（用户授权𝒜、权威证据𝒪、派生后果𝒟）和有向依赖边的有限DAG，每个节点记录值、版本、可用性、权限及父版本。支持六种类型化更新（Commit、Group、Revise、Revoke、Observe、Confirm）。定义三种权限模式（Inherit、Bounded、Confirm）。选择性更新通过受影响节点集I_t^(r)实现；最小修复通过依赖闭包计算最小请求集F_t^(r)。授权决定分三类：Block、Minimal Repair、Authorize。证明最小修复的唯一性与授权决定的终止性。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench的Airline（50任务）和Retail（114任务）领域，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GPT-5.6-Terra、Gemini-3.6-Flash三种模型评估。ACG在六种设置中均取得最佳AS（动作安全率），在五种设置中取得最佳STS（安全任务成功率），不安全任务数从Raw的75降至ACG的8。闭包发现为合理化903项的评估中，ACG以4个修复预算达到91.7%STS，以8个达到100%。token消耗处于62k-99k的中等范围，无需额外守卫模型调用。消融实验验证了选择性更新和最小修复机制的各自贡献。
AI.conclusion: ACG框架通过版本化图结构实现了对LLM智能体授权演化的原则化管理，选择性失效与最小修复工作均满足依赖闭包最小性，并实现强安全性与高任务完成的平衡。局限性包括依赖正确的效果与依赖规范、权威观察与认证确认，以及评估覆盖两个领域与模拟用户的局限。

title: PrismQuant: Optimal Null-Space Rotations for Grouped Quantizers
comment: The paper is currently under review. Code, checkpoints, and implementation details are available at: this https URL
summary: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. Experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral span dense models up to 70B parameters and a 30B mixture-of-experts model. Under W4A4KV4, PrismQuant sets the state of the art on Llama-3.2-3B among the compared methods in both perplexity and accuracy. On Llama-3.1-70B, it attains 3.85 perplexity and 72.46% average zero-shot accuracy, only 0.22 percentage points below full precision. In the deployment study on Llama-3.1-8B, our optimized implementation achieves 1.51x prefill and 1.22x CUDA Graph decode speedups over matched FP16 baselines, with 56.34% lower decode peak memory and only 2.35% additional Graph decode latency over Hadamard. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PrismQuant是一种针对分组非对称INT4量化的旋转框架，通过将主导激活特征空间对齐到量化器的群恒定子空间（group-constant subspace），利用仿射偏移量吸收能量而非扩大群内量化范围。该方法将旋转设计建模为Ky Fan迹最大化问题，具有闭式最优解；采用紧凑WY形式的Householder变换实现无梯度构造，在折合点和在线点均可高效应用。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化中，激活异常值的大小并非决定量化难度的唯一因素——其与量化器的对齐方式同样重要。现有的Hadamard等旋转方法虽能改善激活分布，但未显式利用分组非对称INT4量化器中仿射偏移所"免费"提供的群恒定子空间这一几何结构。论文旨在将量化器自身的几何结构作为旋转设计的显式目标。
AI.method: 方法核心包括三步：(1) 从校准数据估计激活二阶矩Σ的前k个特征向量；(2) 通过紧凑WY形式的Householder反射序列将特征向量映射到k个不同群的第一坐标锚点；(3) 经块Hadamard变换将锚点转化为群恒定方向（由仿射偏移量表示）。旋转设计被形式化为Ky Fan迹最大化问题，具有关于该对齐目标的理论上最优闭式解。Rank参数k控制对齐-成本权衡，无需梯度训练。R1折叠到权重中，R2在值投影后应用，R4在线应用于下投影输入。
AI.result: 在W4A4KV4设置下，Llama-3.2-3B上达到8.58困惑度和61.23%平均零样本准确率（SOTA）；Llama-3.1-70B上达到3.85困惑度和72.46%准确率，仅比全精度低0.22个百分点。相对Hadamard基线，PrismQuant在3B/8B/70B上分别缩小37%/30%/26%的困惑度差距。在Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE模型上恢复Hadamard损失的85%准确率。部署研究（Llama-3.1-8B）实现1.51×预填充和1.22× CUDA Graph解码加速（相对FP16），峰值解码内存降低56.34%，仅比Hadamard多2.35%的Graph解码延迟。
AI.conclusion: PrismQuant从量化器结构出发，将分组格式中"免费"的方向作为旋转显式目标，使旋转设计简化为具有闭式最优解的谱问题。构造简单，对置换、校准集和特征空间求解精度不敏感，可直接扩展到密集模型和稀疏路由专家。预测范围定律将剩余量化步长与未对齐能量和群大小联系起来。未来工作包括原生消费分组的INT4 GEMM核以及扩展到块浮点和微缩放格式。

title: Multi-Agent System Search via Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization
summary: LLMs enable multi-agent systems (MAS) to tackle complex tasks, but manually designing agent roles, prompts, and communication structures requires substantial expertise and effort. This motivates learning policies that construct query-specific MAS from execution reward. Existing approaches typically train these policies by repeatedly traversing a fixed set of training queries and assigning rewards at the workflow level. However, this overlooks differences in queries' evolving learning potential and obscures which substructures improve solution quality. In this paper, we propose Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization (ASPO), a RL framework for query-level MAS search. ASPO introduces an Adaptive Query-Selection Mechanism (AQSM) that focuses training on queries at the policy's competence boundary: those it can solve but not yet reliably. A complementary discovery mechanism widens architectural exploration for hard queries, helping distinguish insufficient exploration from operator capability limits. Beyond query selection, ASPO introduces substructure-level rewards that measure output-quality gains within each action's descendant subgraph. These rewards guide proximal policy optimization to reinforce useful architectural refinements and discourage redundant or harmful computation. Together, these mechanisms prioritize learnable queries and provide fine-grained feedback for learning effective MASs. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, general question answering, and code generation, ASPO ranks first on every benchmark against twelve baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPO（Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization），一种用于查询级多智能体系统（MAS）搜索的强化学习框架。其包含自适应查询选择机制（AQSM）和子结构级奖励两个核心组件，前者聚焦策略能力边界附近的查询，后者对图中每个扩展动作的子结构质量改进进行细粒度信用分配。ASPO在六个基准（数学推理、通用问答、代码生成）上以gpt-4o-mini为骨干，在所有基准上均排名第一，超越了12种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的查询级MAS搜索方法存在两个核心问题：（1）均匀遍历固定训练查询集，忽视了不同查询学习潜力的差异（42.9%查询始终正确、25.7%始终错误），浪费训练预算；（2）使用工作流级别的粗粒度奖励，无法识别哪些子结构真正提升了答案质量，导致强化信号不能有效归因到具体的架构决策上。
AI.method: ASPO框架包含两大组件：（1）自适应查询选择机制（AQSM）——维护每个查询的Beta后验成功概率，通过二值结果方差w(q)=p̃_q(1-p̃_q)优先采样"能解但尚不可靠"的能力边界查询；对从未解出过的查询启动发现模式（额外K=3次rollout）；（2）子结构级奖励——定义每个图扩展动作的奖励为子节点聚合输出与父节点的质量差G(a_i)=r(a_i)+γ/|C_i|·ΣG(a_j)-λ·ΔC_i，结合下游折扣回报与执行成本，通过PPO进行策略优化。状态编码使用GCN（d=128，2层）结合注意力池化，策略通过分支头和算子选择头逐步构建DAG。
AI.result: 在GSM8K（79.08%）、MATH（57.89%）、HotpotQA（81.00 F1）、MMLU-Pro（77.70%）、MBPP+（83.47%）、HumanEval+（90.00%）六个基准上均排名第一，平均分78.19，超越最强基线DyLAN（74.06）4.13分。消融实验表明AQSM贡献2.69分、子结构级奖励贡献3.13分。任务迁移和LLM骨干迁移（gpt-5.6-terra、deepseek-v3.2）中均保持第一。成本分析显示ASPO达到Pareto前沿最高性能端，相比DyLAN性能提升3.88分且成本降低67.4%。超参数敏感性在δ∈[0.85,0.95]、K∈[3,5]范围内表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: ASPO通过将查询选择能力边界化和奖励分配子结构化两个维度的创新，有效解决了查询级MAS搜索中训练反馈不充分的问题。方法在性能、迁移性和成本效益三方面均表现优异，平均秩1.00。未来方向包括支持动态变化的算子池以及在缺乏参考解的任务中寻找替代训练信号。当前局限在于搜索空间受限于预定义算子池，且依赖参考解计算训练奖励。

title: From Latents to Wires: Surgical Post-Editing on Large Language Models
summary: Given a large language model (LLM), can whoever holds the weights name a semantic target (e.g., the model's identity), locate the model components that produce it, and edit them so that the target no longer appears while other capability is preserved? We call such an edit on a trained model a post-edit. We present L2W (latents to wires), a framework that performs surgical post-edits for named semantic targets. For localization, L2W uses Jacobian lens (J-lens) attribution to score components against the semantic target. For surgical removal, because LLM mechanisms are redundant (i.e., a semantic target may have multiple components producing it), L2W runs Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC) until the target no longer appears. CGCC first cumulatively closes model components, treating each surviving expression of the target as a counterexample that exposes the next components to close, and then reopens some of them to preserve capability. In a controlled experiment with an implanted behavioural watermark, L2W removes the watermark, and its localization lands on the model region the implant changed. Across three model configurations, L2W removes model-metadata (e.g., identity) self-claims in all nine runs, and adult-content refusal in all three, with no held-out target residual. L2W further composes two post-edits on a text-to-image model: one removes the refusal of requested nudity, and a second removes the nude rendering the first exposes. The results support post-editing as a complement to post-training: post-training installs preferred behaviours, and post-editing removes named unwanted ones.

AI.tldr: 提出 L2W 框架,通过 Jacobian lens (J-lens) 定位和反例引导因果切割 (CGCC) 迭代闭包模型组件,实现对命名语义目标(身份声明、水印、拒绝行为)的手术式后编辑,在保留模型能力的前提下移除目标行为,并展示了在文生图模型上的多目标组合后编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法擅长"安装"期望行为,但难以"移除"已训练模型中的特定语义目标(如错误身份声明、水印、拒绝行为)。现有消融/编辑方法要么预设目标后围绕其构建分析,要么仅针对特定目标族(如拒绝)。需要一种通用方法:操作者只需用自然语言命名语义目标,即可定位并闭包产生该目标的模型组件,同时保留其他能力。
AI.method: 1) J-lens 定位:使用 Gurnee 等人的 Jacobian lens,将组件在每一层的残差写入通过 J_l^T W_U 解码到词汇空间,计算其对锚点 token 的贡献方向 v_l(tok),并与参考对比,得到 δ 分数以排序产生语义目标的组件。2) CGCC 迭代闭包:从后向前的层搜索,对每个候选组件独立筛选——若能清除至少一个反例且不增加反例数则接纳;闭包策略为零化组件输出。"物理分支"按表现类别和闭包支持索引,锚点漂移即表示目标通过替代路径存活。3) 能力恢复:CGCC 完成后,按 J-lens 记录的最弱贡献组开始,粗到细二分搜索可重开组件,平衡反例数与能力通过数。4) 实验设计:三类探针(Target-Semantic、General-Capability、Target-Conditioned Capability Held-out),使用 LLM 法官和分析师,Claude Opus 4.7 作为判断者。
AI.result: 实验在 Qwen3.5-4B、GLM-4.7-Flash (thinking 开关)和 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 上进行:1) 水印移除:单路由植入 M_wm 切除 9 个组件(其中 2 个在植入通道内),零能力损失;三路由分散植入 M_wm×3 需 315 个组件且基准能力下降明显。2) 元数据移除:九次运行全部清除目标,六次保持能力完整,八次恢复阶段重新打开组件。3) 拒绝移除:三种配置全部清除目标语义,恢复后能力基本恢复,但基准(MMLU/ARC/IFEval)存在显著缺口(尤其 Qwen 在 IFEval 上从 82.07 降至 58.78)。4) 组合编辑:FLUX 模型上连续两次后编辑,先移除服装拒绝再移除裸露渲染,在固定提示下观察从穿衣→裸体→穿衣的演变。5) 与方向性消融对比,L2W 清除更彻底但基准成本更高;思考启用时两者效果接近但 L2W 仍有 3-7 分差距。
AI.conclusion: L2W 将后编辑操作化为实践:每个存活的目标表达都是暴露替代路径的反例,CGCC 逐路由闭包直到目标消失。实验表明 L2W 在语义目标移除与能力保留之间取得平衡。后训练安装期望行为,后编辑移除命名的不期望行为,二者自然组合以填补长期空白。作者指出结构性分散(使目标行为分散且与一般能力纠缠)可作为开源模型开发者防御恶意后编辑的缓解策略,代价是被攻击者切除时将造成更大附带损害。

title: Controllable GNN Explanations via Multi-Metric Preference Selection
summary: Mechanisms for generating GNN explanations are crucial for building trust and mitigating biases in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), especially in high-stakes scenarios. Most current methods optimize only for fidelity under the sparsity constraint. However, this discounts the need for interpretable explanations (those that consist of familiar motif patterns) and stable explanations (those that remain unchanged under structural perturbations). We propose a novel approach that optimizes GNN explanations across these metrics, exposing their relative weighing as a control. Experiments on various real-world datasets, including MUTAG, BA-2Motif, BAMultiShapes, and PROTEINS, suggest that our method produces higher-fidelity explanations than a state-of-the-art baseline on MUTAG and PROTEINS across all evaluated budgets, and on BA-2Motif at larger budgets, while being faster in the regime of small explanation budgets. We also explore how, given an input motif library containing standard motifs for the corresponding domain, the method can be used to determine the relative importance of those motifs in generating the explanations, and how this information can be used to further improve the quality of the output explanations. We also examine the relationship between different metrics through their induced tradeoff surface, and explore its dependence on the nature of the motif library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向图神经网络(GNN)解释的可控多目标优化框架,将解释生成视为保真度(fidelity)、可解释性(interpretability)和稳定性(stability)三个维度的联合优化问题,允许使用者通过指标权重控制旋钮显式指定三者间的相对重要性,并以两阶段蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)实现。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN解释方法几乎都是单目标的——主要仅优化保真度——而忽视了实际应用中同样需要的可解释性(解释由人类熟悉的motif组成)和稳定性(对结构扰动保持一致)。由于不同应用场景对三者侧重不同,需要一种将这些指标作为用户可控参数纳入的框架。
AI.method: 1) 形式化保真度(采用Yuan等人的加权调和平均定义)、可解释性(基于NeuroMatch order-embedding与motif库的偏匹配,按标签相关先验加权)、稳定性(解释对受偏置扰动后的目标图保持一致的能力)三个指标;2) 提出两阶段代理目标:Stage 1用MCTS搜索最大化保真度与可解释性的加权和;Stage 2在目标图上优化稳定性(以扰动图的Stage 1解释作锚);3) 相似性函数实例化为VGAE嵌入(点积+贪心二分匹配)或GNTK核;4) 提供自举机制,允许从自身输出解释中恢复motif-标签相关先验;5) 通过Dirichlet扫描与ρ = w_f/(w_f + w_i)一维扫描刻画权重单纯形上的指标权衡曲面。
AI.result: 在MUTAG、BA-2Motif、BAMultiShapes、PROTEINS四个二分类图数据集上:1) 在MUTAG(B≥8)与BA-2Motif(较大budget)上保真度优于SubgraphX,差距超过种子间噪声;2) 部署运行时为SubgraphX的1.9×–26.7×,budget越小加速越显著(因方法是从小到大增量生长解释);3) 输入motif库与先验对保真度无可测影响,但对可解释性贡献明显(在motif库存在下,方法能在缺乏相关先验时恢复95.2%(VGAE)/99%(GNTK)的可解释性差距);4) 权衡曲面呈现两种模式:在MUTAG上保真度与可解释性负相关(r=−0.95),坍缩为一维比例并存在三个区域;在BA-2Motif上二者正相关(r=+0.92),因motif库与标签对齐而不存在真正的权衡;5) 稳定性指标在本文代理下并非独立——它是保真度与可解释性的相似度加权复合。
AI.conclusion: 本文将GNN解释生成形式化为带显式指标权重的多目标优化问题,提出的两阶段MCTS流程在保真度与运行时上与SOTA基线可比,并在缺乏用户提供的相关先验时仍具竞争力;通过实证揭示了trade-off表面因motif库组成(梯度化vs对齐)而呈现的两种截然不同模式;承认局限性:目标本身仍是线性标量化、稳定性作为独立性质尚未实现、对NeuroMatch等组件的领域适配仍需人工介入;将GNN可解释性定位为更具定制能力的人机协同系统。

title: ForkLeft: Entropy-First Rollouts for Prefix-Aligned Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Distillation
summary: Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has enabled strong reasoning capabilities in language models, while Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible token orders and parallel generation. We ask whether DLMs can acquire NTP-style reasoning through distillation without giving up their native generation process. Direct distillation, however, faces a fundamental mismatch: an autoregressive teacher predicts from a left prefix, whereas a DLM can condition on tokens on both sides. We introduce ForkLeft, a distillation framework that resolves this mismatch by separating the student's rollout from teacher supervision. During training, the student first performs entropy-first rollouts that commit uncertain positions and expose potential forks. We then fix the resulting student prefix and distill an NTP teacher under the same context, with answer correctness determining the supervision source. At inference, the student returns to its native confidence-first parallel decoding. With Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ForkLeft improves Efficient-DLM-4B on all ten benchmarks, raising MATH500 from 72.60% to 79.60% and consistently outperforming three alternative designs. The gains scale with teacher strength and generalize to SDAR-4B with only $500$ updates. At matched scale, the distilled 4B and 8B students exceed the published SDAR-Chat and OPDLM models on seven benchmarks, showing that DLMs can learn NTP-style reasoning without sacrificing native parallel generation. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForkLeft，一种针对扩散语言模型（DLM）的蒸馏框架，旨在使其从自回归（NTP）教师模型中获得推理能力，同时保留其原生的并行解码过程。该方法通过熵优先的rollout暴露不确定决策（即"fork"），再在固定的学生前缀下进行教师监督，从而解决了自回归教师与双向学生之间的信息不对称问题。
AI.motivation: 直接的自回归到扩散蒸馏存在根本性失配：自回归教师仅从左侧前缀预测，而DLM可利用两侧上下文。这种差异导致：(1) 置信度优先的rollout会延迟高熵分支的决策，使教师无法在正确的状态下纠正错误；(2) 双向监督比较将教师知识与学生可见上下文混淆。文章旨在解决这两个耦合问题。
AI.method: ForkLeft包含四个核心组件：(1) 熵优先的学生rollout——先提交高熵token以暴露不确定分支；(2) 正确性路由——根据学生与教师答案的对错选择监督来源（CE、KL、参考CE或丢弃）；(3) 前缀对齐教学——教师与学生均基于相同的学生生成左侧前缀预测目标token，使用均匀采样选择监督位置；(4) 置信度正则化——通过全掩码与前缀读出的熵差作为排序信号，训练仅使用的正则化项塑造推理时的置信度优先级。推理时恢复原生置信度优先并行解码。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base教师下蒸馏Efficient-DLM-4B，ForkLeft在10个基准测试上全部提升：MATH500从72.60%升至79.60%（+7.00pp），GSM8K从82.71%升至85.22%，MT-AIME从8.55%升至15.82%。消融实验显示熵优先rollout与前缀对齐的组合在所有基准上最优，平均增益+4.93pp。增益随教师强度单调上升（Qwen3-4B: +2.91pp → Qwen3-30B: +4.93pp），且能泛化至SDAR-4B（仅500次更新）。在匹配规模下，蒸馏后的4B与8B学生在7个任务上超过已发布的SDAR-Chat与OPDLM模型。
AI.conclusion: ForkLeft证明了扩散语言模型可以学习自回归风格的推理能力而无需牺牲其原生并行生成过程。该方法揭示了一个原则：最适合学习的状态与最安全的解码状态不必相同。学生可在训练时面对其分支并在教师所拥有的信息下被纠正，同时仍以偏好的顺序进行解码。

title: PULSE: Identifying Demonstration-Utility Features with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: In-context learning is highly sensitive to demonstration choice, yet most methods select demonstrations using external query-demonstration similarity. Such criteria can miss model-specific signals: Similar demonstrations may activate different internal features and downstream behaviors. We introduce PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings), an SAE-based framework for identifying model-internal features associated with demonstration utility and using them for demonstration selection. Using a small labeled discovery set, PULSE samples candidate demonstration sets, measures their zero-shot-relative utility under the target model, and scores SAE features by how their activation differences align with utility differences. The top positive and negative coordinates form a sparse utility-localization vector. We use this vector in two complementary ways: as a signed score for controlled complete-set ranking, and as PULSE-Retriever, which converts its magnitude into a feature-relevance mask for scalable pool-scale retrieval. Across classification, generation, and reasoning benchmarks, PULSE-Retriever improves over the strongest baseline by 2-3 accuracy points, 0.6-0.9 BLEU-4, and 3.2 exact-match points, respectively, while controlled ranking validates the identified features encode a predictive set-level utility signal. Feature inspection and cross-dataset experiments suggest that the identified features capture task-relevant, dataset-conditioned patterns, yet retain utility signals that partially transfer across datasets. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PULSE 是一个基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的框架，通过配对效用定位在 SAE 特征空间中识别与上下文学习（ICL）示例效用相关的模型内部特征，并将其用于示例选择，在分类、生成和推理任务上均优于基于外部相似度的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 ICL 示例选择方法主要依赖查询与示例之间的外部相似度（词汇或语义），但不同 LLM 对示例的偏好不同，效用不仅取决于外部匹配，还取决于示例激活了模型内部哪些特征。密集激活中神经元具有多义性，难以直接分离效用信号，因此需要可解释的特征分解工具。
AI.method: PULSE 包含三个核心组件：(1) 利用小型有标签发现集，对候选示例集进行采样并形成配对，计算其零样本相对效用差异 Δ𝒰 与 SAE 激活差异 ΔA 的对齐得分，挑选得分最高的 K⁺ 正向和 K⁻ 负向特征形成 utility-localization vector w_l；(2) PULSE-Ranking 实验：以 w_l 的符号得分对预采样完整示例集进行排序验证；(3) PULSE-Retriever：使用 |w_l| 作为特征相关性掩码，结合标准 SAE 余弦相似度进行池规模检索，通过短名单+贪心去冗余构造最终 k-shot 上下文。模型涵盖 Gemma2-2B 和 Llama3.1-8B，任务涵盖 AGNews、REST14、LAP14、EMOC（分类）、CommonGen（生成）、GSM8K（推理）。
AI.result: 在 PULSE-Ranking 实验中，32 个数据集-shot-骨干设置中有 30 个取得最佳或并列最佳，平均比 KNN-SAE 基线高 3.89（Gemma2-2B）和 3.48（Llama3.1-8B）个百分点。在池规模检索中，PULSE-Retriever 在 32 个分类设置中的 25 个取得最佳，比 KNN-SAE 平均提升 2.93（Gemma2-2B）和 1.99（Llama3.1-8B）个百分点。在生成和推理任务上，CommonGen BLEU-4 提升 0.6–0.9，GSM8K 精确匹配提升 3.2 个百分点。消融实验表明 SAE 特征空间优于 PCA 和原始隐藏状态，且仅用 64 个发现查询即可超越使用 128 查询的 EPR 风格学习检索器。特征检查显示高权重特征捕获主题锚点、方面-观点绑定、情感线索等任务相关模式。跨数据集实验（LOO∪）显示特征具有部分可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: PULSE 将 ICL 示例选择重构为模型内部稀疏特征识别问题，证明了利用 SAE 识别与示例效用相关的内部特征能够显著优于依赖外部相似度的选择方法。识别出的特征具有可解释性和部分跨任务迁移能力，但并非单一任务无关的效用方向。未来工作包括多模态 ICL 扩展、长度匹配的示例集设计以及因果干预研究。

title: VPEvolve: A Self-Evolving Virtual Process Engineer for Computational Lithography
summary: Optical proximity correction (OPC) recipes grow as engineers add local rules to repair newly discovered lithography hotspots. Each correction can interact with existing rules, while lessons from commercial-tool trials remain scattered across code and logs. \system combines a Virtual Process Engineer (VPE) harness with a Skill Bank of measured engineering experience. The harness equips a frozen language model with process manuals, layout analysis, recipe editing, and commercial-tool evaluation. The actor proposes changes to the global parameters, local targeted rules, or diagnostic trials. After each evaluation, an LLM reflector and curator turn the measured response into evidence-linked judgments. The actor retrieves them before its next trial. Feasible improvements update the retained recipe; every measured trial informs the Skill Bank that guides the next edit. The model weights remain fixed. On a FreePDK45-derived benchmark with ten commercial-tool evaluations per case, \system reduces the mean per-case maximum edge placement error from 18.294 to 5.361 nm on Poly and from 22.052 to 15.692 nm on Metal1. Every final recipe satisfies the predefined quality constraints and improves the maximum error by at least 0.1 nm.

AI.tldr: VPEvolve提出了一种自我进化的虚拟工艺工程师(VPE)框架，将冻结的大语言模型与光刻仿真工具相结合，通过Actor-Reflector-Curator循环在光学邻近效应校正(OPC)配方开发中同时优化配方和工程经验库(Skill Bank)，在FreePDK45基准上将最大边缘放置误差降低了28.8%-70.7%。
AI.motivation: 传统OPC配方开发中，工程师需要手动添加局部规则修复光刻热点，每次修改可能与现有规则交互，且商业工具试验中的经验分散在代码和日志中难以复用。现有方法（如贝叶斯优化）仅覆盖模型参数调优，无法处理工程师发现新热点后添加局部规则的情况；而直接使用LLM的方法会因为配方变化导致历史经验失效或误导。
AI.method: 1）将配方开发形式化为序贯决策问题：在固定预算B次商业工具评估下，最小化最大边缘放置误差(EPE)，同时满足平均EPE、工艺变化带(PVB)、MRC和SRAF印刷等约束。2）VPE Harness：冻结LLM作为Actor，配备工艺手册、布局分析、配方编辑和商业工具评估工具，可选择全局编辑、局部校正或诊断试验。3）Self-Evolving Skill Bank：在ACE风格反思策展基础上引入三个组件：领域响应反思（区分无效纠正与目标修复后产生新瓶颈）、范围化经验修订（添加/更新/拆分/合并工程判断，保留证据链接）、实验引导（附加策略更新和后续实验建议）。4）所有三个角色共享同一个冻结模型，模型权重和工具链保持不变，配方和经验库均可独立演化。
AI.result: 在20个FreePDK45窗口（10个Poly+10个Metal1）的基准测试中，使用Qwen3.6-27B模型和每次案例10次商业工具评估：Poly层最大EPE从18.294降至5.361 nm（降幅70.7%），Metal1层从22.052降至15.692 nm（降幅28.8%），均优于7个基线（Raw Actor、ReAct、Textual Memory、ReasoningBank、ACE、Static Harness、贝叶斯优化），且100%成功率；机制消融验证了三个组件均对性能有贡献；冻结经验变体在Metal1上57次试验后即终止；VPEvolve在6种不同LLM（Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、GLM、Gemma）上均能持续改进配方质量。
AI.conclusion: 将配方开发和经验积累统一在同一闭环中，使每次试验既能改进当前配方，又能为后续决策提供证据；VPEvolve为计算光刻中的OPC配方开发提供了一种可复用、可进化的自动化解决方案，配套发布的FreePDK45版图和光刻仿真器为开放研究奠定了基础。

title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.

title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

AI.tldr: 提出DMD-EEG框架，将EEG诊断与疾病表征分离：固定头皮频谱专家负责诊断，源空间专家通过健康神经动力学先验的低秩稀疏迭代形变生成可解释的ROI×频率×滞后状态，在决策级融合。在MDD、FEP、PD三个任务上验证，源空间归因与已知疾病回路一致，MDD状态可跨采集系统迁移。
AI.motivation: 闭环神经调控需要受试者特定的结构化状态（哪些脑区、在哪些频率、在哪些滞后出现异常），而非单一疾病概率。现有方法存在三类不足：传感器空间模型保留最强诊断证据但缺乏解剖信息；源空间模型提供解剖但损失预测信号；后验归因在预测之外。作者主张将诊断与疾病表征分离而非强行融合到同一表征中。
AI.method: DMD-EEG（Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG）采用双专家架构：(1) 传感器专家：固定的PSD+逻辑回归分类器，映射头皮谱特征至诊断概率；(2) 源专家：首先通过sLORETA进行源重建，使用在269名健康被试上预训练的振荡保持CNN（OP-CNN）生成健康神经动力学先验h⁰（含46 ROI×5频段×4真实滞后），然后通过低秩（r≤2）、稀疏、Top-m（m=460）迭代形变求解器对h⁰进行K步（每病种不同）形变得到Δh^K；两专家仅在固定决策级（α=0.5平均）融合。形变限制在低秩共享疾病子空间V_D，幅度由受试者条件化的小网络预测。
AI.result: 在严格受试者级多种子保持集协议下：(1) MDD：融合AUC 0.700，传感器0.622，源0.622；(2) FEP：融合AUC 0.789，源专家为最强单分支（0.794），跨种子标准差减半（0.139→0.055）；(3) PD：融合AUC 0.780，超过源分支（0.638，ΔAUC +0.176，95% CI排除零）。传感器-源Spearman相关性低（0.46/0.25/0.17），表明互补。高显著性ROI与已知疾病回路一致：MDD为前额-边缘-颞区，FEP为额-顶-岛叶，PD为运动皮层β频段。MDD源分支在跨采集系统的独立队列中排序AUC达0.724±0.042。无变形控制（K=0）FEP AUC从0.794降至0.678，PD去掉健康预训练后AUC从0.638降至0.415。
AI.conclusion: 分离诊断与解剖协调的疾病表征在临床EEG中可行：简单头皮专家保留诊断证据，而健康动力学条件的低秩形变模型在显式ROI×频率×滞后坐标中学习独立可预测的源空间状态。决策级融合在MDD和FEP上与最佳分支在种子噪声内匹配，在PD上超过源分支。源分支在FEP上为最强单专家，在MDD和FEP上方向可复现。其ROI-频率-滞后归因与已知疾病回路一致，对MDD可迁移到不同采集的队列。该可复现、解剖索引的轴为未来神经调控工作提供了结构化状态基础。

title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
summary: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)，一种基于杠杆分数的可扩展数据多样化采样方法，用于语言模型预训练数据选择。它通过迭代选择杠杆分数最高的样本来最大化嵌入数据的行列式体积，相比DiSF基线实现72×加速、Vendi多样性分数提升9.2%，在CommonCrawl上七项下游任务准确率最高提升1.31%，在StarCoderData上BPB降低3.08%。研究还揭示了质量过滤会引发跨域维度坍塌（如系统性排除代码内容），倡导将多样性感知选择整合到质量过滤流程中。
AI.motivation: 语言模型预训练数据选择面临质量与多样性的根本矛盾：基于fastText的质量过滤虽然有效，但因偏向类QA/教育类高质量参考语料，会导致多样性坍塌，系统性排除欠表示领域（如代码）的宝贵数据。现有多样化方法存在局限：覆盖导向方法只能间接促进多样性；直接优化多样性的方法（如DiSF）需要每候选协方差矩阵重计算，计算成本高昂，难以扩展。
AI.method: 方法核心是Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)算法：1) 理论基础——将数据集多样性与Gram矩阵的行列式体积相关联，通过矩阵行列式引理证明候选样本z的杠杆分数ℓλ(z;X) = z⊤(1/n·X⊤X + λI)⁻¹z恰好量化加入样本后行列式体积的相对膨胀量(Theorem 3.1)；2) 通过SVD分解证明ℓλ(z;X) = Σᵢz̃ᵢ²/(σᵢ²+λ)，其中σᵢ²是主语义方向的出现频率，因此欠表示语义会被赋予更高权重，自动识别稀有多样样本(Theorem 3.2)；3) 算法采用分批处理策略，对每批进行Cholesky分解后通过求解三角系统Lw=z计算所有候选杠杆分数（共享单一Gram矩阵），无需逐候选重计算协方差矩阵，时间复杂度O(DBd²)相比DiSF的O(DB²d²)降低一个数量级。
AI.result: 1) 多样性指标：Lev在7项多样性指标上全部最优，Vendi分数比Random提升21.3%（168.06→203.81）、比DiSF提升9.2%（186.63→203.81）；2) CommonCrawl下游性能（1.1B模型，60B tokens）：50%选择比例下七项任务平均准确率48.17%，最优；比DSIR提升1.31%，表现更均衡（DiSF在HS等任务明显落后）；3) StarCoderData代码性能：50%选择比例+DCLM过滤CC数据时，代码平均BPB从Random的66.26降至63.66（降3.92%），比DiSF降3.08%；4) 运行效率：CommonCrawl选择Lev仅需3.03h vs DiSF 217.28h（72×加速），StarCoderData 1.03h vs 67.45h（65×加速），加速比随batch size增大而扩大；5) 消融实验证明步长b、batch size B、选择比例α在合理范围内均鲁棒；6) 重要发现：质量过滤（DCLM-fastText）引发跨域维度坍塌——从CC中保留代码相关内容不足，即使补充Lev筛选的代码数据，代码性能差距仍然存在，表明这是开源评分器的普遍问题。
AI.conclusion: Lev是一种高效可扩展的多样化数据选择方法，理论上以杠杆分数作为多样性信号，通过Gram矩阵的行列式体积展开来最大化几何多样性。实验证明其在多样性、下游性能、运行效率三方面均优于现有基线，特别适合缺乏稳健质量标准的领域（如代码）作为无监督策展手段。核心贡献是揭示了质量过滤固有的跨域维度坍塌问题，倡导将多样性感知实践整合到质量过滤中，以构建更鲁棒的预训练数据策展流程。未来需深入研究如何统一整合多样性与质量目标。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了三模态视觉问答（VQA）中一类新型决策级文本偏见——选项重定向偏见（Option-Redirecting Bias），并提出诊断框架与免训练推理干预方法予以缓解。
AI.motivation: 在多模态VQA系统中，辅助文本（如字幕、OCR输出、检索描述）常被引入以增强推理，但其可靠性难以控制。现有研究多聚焦于模态冲突的检测或广义鲁棒性，鲜有工作系统性地分析不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何在决策层面影响答案选择。核心疑问是——为何某些辅助文本能系统性地将模型预测重定向至特定错误选项。
AI.method: 1. 提出"文本可靠性阶梯"（Textual Reliability Ladder）：一种受控诊断协议，沿图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持三个维度构建五类辅助文本条件（忠实Faithful、离题Off-Question、矛盾Contradictory、选项重定向Option-Redirecting、无关Irrelevant）及无辅助基线，固定图像-问题-选项，仅变换辅助文本以隔离其因果效应。2. 提出两阶段免训练推理时干预方法：阶段一为噪声稳定性引导（NSS），基于正确/重定向答案续写之间的对比残差，通过PCA离线估计模态特定的全局转向方向并以前向钩子注入视觉编码器与文本解码器；阶段二为动态接地（DG），在线选取与问题最相关的Top-K图像token，计算辅助文本末位token与视觉证据之间的修正方向，自适应地调整文本token的隐藏状态。两阶段形成粗到细的互补架构。
AI.result: 在四个多模态VQA基准（ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA）与六种开源VLM（Qwen2.5VL 3B/7B、Qwen3VL 4B/8B、InternVL3.5 4B/8B）上：1. 选项重定向文本引发最大且最一致的精度下降（最高达53.1个百分点），且错误集中于特定重定向干扰项而非弥散性混乱；2. 模型规模提升并未消除此偏见，甚至在某些场景下随规模增大而加剧；3. 所提NSS+DG干预在选项重定向条件下带来最大精度提升（最高+14.6个百分点），显著降低重定向预测率，同时在忠实文本条件下基本保持原有性能；4. 消融实验验证两阶段互补——NSS提供保守的全局稳定，DG提供实例级针对性修正。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，辅助文本的可靠性必须在决策层面而非仅凭事实正确性来理解。最具破坏性的辅助文本并非最明显错误的，而是与问题对齐但与图像矛盾并隐式支持特定干扰项的"选项重定向"文本，由此产生系统性的、选项针对性的错误而非弥散性不确定性。冻结VLM评估与"文本可靠性阶梯"框架为决策级文本偏见的归因诊断提供了严谨方法论。所提免训练两阶段推理干预为提升三模态推理鲁棒性提供了实用路径。

title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks. To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving. Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"渐进式规约任务"(progressively specified tasks)的新问题设定，其中任务需求在初始请求中未被完全明确，而是在推理、工具使用或执行过程中逐步显现。为此，作者构建了 ProgSpec 基准（270 个跨 Coding/Math/QA 的任务），并提出了受 GitHub 开源项目管理启发的 RepoMAS 多智能体框架。RepoMAS 将执行反馈转化为结构化 Issue，通过补丁生成、验证和局部重执行来动态修订任务规约和执行结构。在六个数据集上的实验表明 RepoMAS 达到最佳性能，其核心机制（结构化 Issue、补丁验证、结构性修订、局部重执行）均对性能有显著贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）普遍假设任务规约在执行前已充分明确，但实际场景中许多要求只有在推理、工具调用或执行过程中才会显现。如何让 MAS 在执行过程中动态发现并修订任务规约，是当前研究的不足之处。
AI.method: RepoMAS 的核心设计借鉴开源项目管理流程：(1) 维护仓库状态（包括 Task Draft、Task Graph、Agent Graph、Issue 列表和产物）；(2) 将执行反馈记录为结构化 Issue（含类型、影响组件、问题描述、证据）；(3) 通过补丁机制对仓库组件（Task Draft、Task Graph、Agent Graph、任务-智能体映射）进行协调修订；(4) 补丁在合并前需经独立验证；(5) 仅对受影响子图进行局部重执行，未受影响结果可复用。RepoMAS 同时构建了 ProgSpec 基准，将需求分为 L1（显式）、L2（隐式）、L3（潜在）三级，采用加权需求覆盖率作为评估指标。
AI.result: 使用 GPT-4o-mini 作为骨干模型时，RepoMAS 在六个基准上均取得最高成绩：ProgSpec 加权覆盖率 44.7%（超过最强基线 Meta-Agent 1.8 点），HumanEval 99.2%，MBPP 87.1%，HotpotQA 75.5%，DROP 86.3%，GSM8K 95.8%。消融实验显示四个核心组件（结构化 Issue、补丁验证、结构性修订、局部重执行）均有重要贡献，其中结构化 Issue 组件在 ProgSpec 上从 44.7 降至 30.8（移除后）。在 GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.7 Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 等其他骨干模型上同样表现良好。RepoMAS 在 L3 需求上的满足比例（24.4%）高于单智能体基线（19.6%）。代价是更高的 token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: RepoMAS 验证了"在执行过程中修订任务规约的显式表征"这一思路的有效性，对渐进式规约任务和传统基准均带来了稳定的性能提升。结构化 Issue、补丁验证、结构性协同修订是框架的关键贡献，但代价是更高的计算开销。人类验证表明 ProgSpec 标注具有较高质量（一致性 AC1=0.91）。

title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
summary: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

AI.tldr: SPARO提出了一种面向模块化语言程序的归因引导优化框架，将提示词、技能库和路由规则作为可联合优化的组件，通过反事实评估将失败归责到具体组件并采样定向变异，在五个基准和五个工作模型上一致优于仅优化提示词或仅优化技能的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有语言程序优化方法通常只搜索提示词或单独提炼技能，缺乏一种原则化机制来判断失败时应更新哪个组件，难以在统一框架中联合优化提示词、技能和技能调用策略。端到端任务反馈无法直接定位故障组件，而错误可能源于提示词欠规范、过程性知识缺失或错误的技能激活决策。
AI.method: 1. 将语言程序表示为P=(p,B,r,t)，分别对应全局提示词、可复用技能库、语义路由器和集成模板；2. 维护聚类平衡的跨轮次经验池，每轮用当前程序重新标注示例；4. 对每个查询示例构建组件特定反事实（提示词重写、技能增删、新技能注入），计算各组件贡献度；4. 用Softmax将贡献度转化为示例级责任分布，聚合后采样待编辑组件；5. 对选中组件施加定向变异（PromptEdit/SkillEdit/RoutingEdit），候选程序经验证集评估后通过Paware程序池选择保留。
AI.result: 在FinQA、CLUTRR、ChartQA、ProofWriter、SearchQA五个基准上，使用Qwen3.5-4B、GLM-4.6V-Flash、InternVL3.5-8B、MiniCPM-V-4.5、Gemma4-31B五个工作模型，SPARO在全部25个模型-任务设置中均取得最高分，平均超过最强基线4.4分，最大差距达15.1分；消融实验显示去掉技能或归因机制平均损失超21分；组件选择模式随任务自适应调整，路由变异在所有设置中均保持11.1%–33.3%的非平凡占比。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅取决于发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定该知识应存储在何处以及何时被激活；通过将模块化程序视为异构组件并以归因指导变异生成，可在小优化器监督大工作模型时仍获得稳定增益。

title: DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents
summary: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.

AI.tldr: DAAF提出从故障定位转向可编辑系统资产的修复决策，通过干预监督学习替换效果，将故障检测与组件-属性归因结合，在τ²-bench Telecom任务上实现80.72%的属性Hit@1和62.65%的故障恢复率。
AI.motivation: 现有故障定位方法仅能识别错误出现的位置（智能体身份、执行步骤、模块标签），但无法直接对应到可被修改和独立重评估的版本化系统资产（如路由规则、知识段、提示指令、可复用技能）。修复决策需要确定哪个具体系统变更可能改善任务结果，而定位与修复之间存在显著的研究空白。
AI.method: Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF) 包含三大模块：(1) MSWSD（多信号弱监督检测）——利用数据编程范式显式表示信号缺失，结合行为不一致、轨迹异常和用户反馈等弱信号估计干预必要性；(2) CTCA（组件类型条件归因）——通过Shapley风格的边际效应在组合替换设置中学习类型条件化的有符号替换效果，训练时使用控制重放评估任务结果；(3) 跨请求一致性学习——基于请求兼容性和干预响应相似性构建固定训练邻域，共享修复证据。诊断时无需反事实重放或任务奖励，输出no_change、修复目标或unresolved三种决策。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench Telecom 114个留出任务上（83个自然失败+31个自然成功），DAAF达到80.72%属性Hit@1、68.02%联合F1、62.65%±3.19%故障恢复率、3.23%±3.23%干净任务退化率和71.93%±1.52%总体任务成功率，显著优于组件感知LLM基线（40.96% Hit@1, 35.74%恢复率）。控制干预分析显示非零替换效果从独立编辑的11.36%提升至组合设置的31.02%，支持上下文相关归因。仅检测控制降至4.42%恢复率，证明效果监督的必要性。在Who&When轨迹级定位上保留48.02% Step和25.86% Joint准确率。
AI.conclusion: DAAF成功弥合了故障定位与可执行系统修复之间的鸿沟，证明了基于干预的属性归因能够将版本化、可寻址的系统资产与故障检测连接起来。当前方法假设已注册的候选集，将自动资产发现和替换内容生成留给未来工作。

title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
summary: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.

AI.tldr: 提出TreeRef分子表示（基于k叉树的统一表示，同时编码分子大小、拓扑与局部内坐标几何）和TreeRef-BFN生成模型（基于Bayesian Flow Network + 标准Transformer，无需等变架构），在QM9和GEOM-Drugs上实现非条件生成、变尺寸条件生成（2D→3D、片段补全、scaffold修饰/linker生成）及属性条件逆合成，单一预训练模型通过masking支持多任务。
AI.motivation: 现有de novo 3D分子生成方法存在两大局限：1）多数方法预先采样分子大小，限制片段补全、scaffold修饰等变尺寸条件任务；2）Cartesian坐标方法依赖等变架构，而内坐标方法需要已知分子图或自回归构造（误差累积）。本文希望找到一种统一的分子表示，使分子大小、拓扑与局部内坐标几何能在同一结构支撑上联合生成，且无需等变架构或自回归构造。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) **TreeRef表示**：将分子编码为BFS遍历的满k叉树（k=3），每个slot z_i = (R_i, E_i, B_i, G_i, Q_i, H_i)编码角色、元素、键、局部几何（键长+成对键角cos+二面角(cosφ,sinφ)）、形式电荷与手性。Null节点表示占用类别（非padding），分子大小由节点占用情况自然涌现。RingRef虚拟节点编码非树边（环闭合），共享树结构支撑。 (2) **TreeRef-BFN生成器**：采用Bayesian Flow Network联合建模离散变量（类别BFN）与连续局部几何（高斯BFN），共享流时间t，使用带AdaLN-Zero条件化的标准Transformer（无等变性），通过masking实现多种条件任务。可选的多视图一致性正则化L_inv鼓励不同BFS序列化产生一致池化表示。 (3) **解码器**：将TreeRef变量通过拓扑构建、几何构建（含Gram矩阵兼容性裁剪与平面fallback）、RingRef联合闭环（最小化虚拟点到目标原子的总距离）转换为分子图与Cartesian坐标，无需迭代优化。
AI.result: 在QM9上：100步采样达到96.56% RDKit有效性、96.19%分子稳定性，键长/键角/二面体W₁距离分别为0.0040Å/0.500°/1.187°（均为最低），10000分子仅需12.3秒；在GEOM-Drugs上100步达到82.4%有效性、80.1%稳定性，几何分布距离同样最低；2D→3D生成在Frozen条件下有效率64.65%（L模型），M-inv2达94.55%；片段编辑中M-inv2在scaffold replacement任务上将成功率从33.6%提升至63.8%；属性条件生成在100步时在gap、HOMO、LUMO上MAE均低于NExT-Mol与PropMolFlow。消融实验验证了成对键角编码与RingRef统一表示的必要性。
AI.conclusion: TreeRef-BFN建立了高效灵活的3D分子生成框架：TreeRef表示统一了分子大小、拓扑与局部几何的联合建模，Bayesian Flow Network配合标准Transformer实现了无需等变架构、无需自回归的离散-连续联合生成，masking机制使单一预训练模型支持无条件生成、2D→3D转换、变尺寸片段补全/编辑/逆合成等多种任务，在QM9与GEOM-Drugs上展现出化学有效性、稳定性、多样性、局部几何精度、采样速度与属性条件精度的综合优势。

title: Learning from Others, Acting for You: Cross-User Memory Sharing for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents serving different users often solve related tasks, yet separate user histories can leave reusable experience inaccessible to other agents. Pooling memories expands access but risks transferring preferences that conflict with the receiving user's requirements. We introduce ShareMem, a memory architecture that shares reusable experience while grounding its application in the receiving user's own preferences. Shared experiences indicate how to act and which preferences to consult; the receiving user's memory supplies their concrete values. Two-stage consolidation refines experience locally before integrating accepted edits into a shared pool. During execution, scope-first retrieval jointly selects local and shared experiences under a common entry budget, while a user-bound channel supports initial and agent-initiated preference retrieval. We evaluate ShareMem across web navigation (Mind2Web), online personalized interaction (VitaBench~2.0), and multi-session coding (MemoryCode) with four backbone models. It improves step success, average task success, and dialogue-macro coding scores, respectively, over matched user-local memory across all four models. Ablations favor two-stage consolidation for smaller shared pools, lower induction token usage, and better downstream performance, and support complementarity between experience guidance and active preference retrieval. Further analyses show that sharing helps most when relevant local experience is scarce, while source quality and cross-user preference interference limit useful transfer.

AI.tldr: ShareMem是一种面向LLM智能体的跨用户记忆共享架构，通过两阶段经验整合与用户绑定的偏好检索，在共享可复用经验的同时，将具体偏好值的获取限定在接收用户自身的记忆内，从而在网页导航、个性化交互和多会话编码三类任务上稳定优于纯本地记忆。
