AI.result: 在Search-R1+DeepMath数据集上训练，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct作为Action Planner。在四个基准测试类别共10个数据集上取得SOTA：(1) 知识密集搜索：Bamboogle 81.6%, 2Wiki 81.5%, HotpotQA 69.0%, Musique 35.0%；(2) 智能体推理GAIA：41.7%；(3) 数学推理：AIME24 50.0%, AMC23 72.5%, GameOf24 65.0%；(4) 科学推理：GPQA 59.0%, MedQA 86.0%。7B模型在所有搜索基准上超越GPT-4o，Qwen3.5-9B版本进一步提升至85.6%/85.0%/77.0%/40.0%/49.6%。消融实验验证了多层级监督和focal加权（最优γ=2.0）的有效性，且λ_Φ-MPO比λ_DPO权重更关键。增大推理轮数T从3到10可持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: Φ-MPO作为一种新颖的智能体学习框架，有效解决了长程推理和数据不平衡的双重挑战。理论分析证明了DPO与GRPO的成对等价性以及focal加权对简单多数支配的抑制作用。大量实验表明该方法在多个智能体推理基准上达到SOTA，且在跨模型规模（3B/7B/9B）和不同骨干网络（Qwen2.5/Qwen3.5）下均具有良好可扩展性。局限性在于对focal参数γ、rollout多样性和奖励可靠性的敏感性。

title: ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces
summary: Information-seeking agents increasingly operate over information spaces that are too large to process exhaustively. Yet many multi-agent systems organize computation around static partitions of the available space, causing coordination to grow with how information is segmented rather than with what the query still requires. We introduce ANTMAN, an adaptive coordination framework that treats evolving unresolved information needs as the unit of runtime coordination. ANTMAN maintains a revisable Need Graph that tracks unresolved requirements, accumulated evidence, prior attempts, and search progress, and uses this state to control worker selection, routing, and task-local recovery as new evidence is discovered. By separating the coordination policy from substrate-specific search interfaces, the same need-conditioned mechanism can operate across different information spaces. Experiments across multi-document question answering, controlled long-context scaling, and realistic structured navigation show that ANTMAN remains effective across settings, including when execution is delegated to substantially smaller worker models. Under a 16x increase in searchable context, ANTMAN increases active coordination by only 1.23x, compared with more than 15x for partition-driven baselines, while preserving strong answer quality.

AI.tldr: ANTMAN是一种多智能体信息检索协调框架，将演化中的信息需求作为协调的基本单元而非静态空间划分，从而在大幅扩展的信息空间中保持恒定的协调开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体长上下文系统（如LongAgent、CoA）采用静态分区策略，将输入划分为固定大小的块并分配给各工作智能体，导致协调开销随信息空间线性增长，与查询实际需求严重脱节。此外，传统的信息检索缺乏对"未解决需求"的显式可修订表示，难以适应搜索过程中不断变化的信息需求。
AI.method: ANTMAN框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 静态基底映射——将信息空间确定性划分为M个领域(territories)，每个领域关联一个轻量级的WorkerCard描述其内容范围；(2) 可修订需求图(Need Graph)——作为运行时控制状态，显式追踪每个未解决需求的解决状态、累积证据、历史尝试和进度信号，支持需求的解决、重构、再路由和回退等动态更新；(3) 需求驱动的协调机制——基于当前需求图选择未解决需求，路由到对应领域的工作智能体进行有界本地信息检索，当进度停滞时触发任务级恢复。该框架通过公式|A(q)| ≤ min{M, ρH(q)}形式化证明了协调开销与查询需求而非空间大小相关。
AI.result: 在三个评估场景中均表现优异：(1) 标准多文档QA上ANTMAN在HotpotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue上平均EM/F1达0.711/0.814，超越所有基线；(2) 控制性空间扩展测试中，当信息空间增长16倍时，ANTMAN的活跃协调仅增长1.23倍（LongAgent和CoA超过15倍），且F1提升+0.065；(3) 现实结构化导航中，ANTMAN在RepoProbe、SWE-QA-Pro和GAIA上分别超越最强基线15.3%、18.4%和27.9%。使用Qwen3-8B小型工作模型时仍保留89.2%-98.3%的性能。位置鲁棒性测试显示ANTMAN中间位置差距仅+0.015，而全上下文推理为-0.181。消融实验验证了需求修订、适应性重路由和恢复机制的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: ANTMAN证明了协调开销无需与信息空间大小绑定。通过将演化中的未解决信息需求作为运行时控制状态，可以同时实现空间可扩展性和强答案质量。该框架为多智能体信息检索提供了一种新的设计范式：协调应随查询需求而非信息可用量增长。未来工作将聚焦于更丰富的信息基底、可迁移的需求表示以及更精细的修订和路由策略。

title: Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching for Sign Language Production
summary: Sign Language Production (SLP) aims to generate sign motions from text. Conditional Flow Matching methods have achieved strong performance in SLP by constructing conditional paths that transform a source distribution into a target distribution. However, existing methods construct these paths via linear interpolation, whereas the rotational geometry of human joints confines valid joint rotations to a manifold embedded in Euclidean space. Consequently, linear interpolation between two sign motions leaves this manifold and ignores the motion distribution on it. In this paper, we revisit SLP from the perspective of manifold transport and propose a Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching framework, termed \textbf{SignNMFlow}, which constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold by jointly considering geometric efficiency and the motion distribution. Specifically, we exploit the intrinsic geometry of the manifold and introduce a motion naturalness measure to characterize the motion distribution. By minimizing the kinetic energy under this measure, we learn a naturalness-guided interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic, which provides geometrically efficient transport, with a learnable deviation that incorporates the motion distribution, thereby significantly improving the fidelity of generated sign motions. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SignNMFlow框架，将手语生成(SLP)从流匹配视角重新建模为流形上的传输问题，通过在单位四元数乘积流形上构造自然度引导的条件路径（耦合闭式测地线与可学习偏差），解决了现有基于条件流匹配(CFM)的SLP方法因欧氏空间线性插值而偏离关节旋转流形的几何失配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于条件流匹配(CFM)的手语生成方法（如SignFlow、SignSparK）通过欧氏空间的线性插值构造条件路径，但人体关节旋转构成SO(3)^J流形，线性插值会产生违反正交性约束的中间状态（Property 1），且忽略了手语运动的分布特性，导致生成的运动偏离流形且与运动分布不一致。
AI.method: 1) 使用单位四元数乘积流形 M=(S³)^J 表示手语运动；2) 通过K-means聚类提取K个原型运动，定义基于核加权散度矩阵的运动自然度测度 G(x)=m(x)(S(x)+ρI)^{-1}，将其从点提升为路径上的动能度量；3) 通过最小化自然度测度下的动能，学习自然度引导插值 x_t=Exp_{x0}(t·Log_{x0}(x1) + t(1-t)·ε_θ)，耦合闭式测地线（几何项）与可学习偏差（自然度项）；4) 采用目标预测参数化（而非速度预测）训练生成网络φ，沿冻结的修正网络ε_θ定义的路径进行推理。
AI.result: 在Phoenix-2014T、CSL-Daily和How2Sign三个数据集上，手部DTW-PA-JPE分别达到1.07、1.30、2.07，BLEU-4分别达到16.15、15.14、16.88，均超越现有SOTA方法；用户研究中81.11%的偏好率显著优于SOKE(7.78%)和SignFlow(11.11%)；推理效率上以233.20M参数和0.0103秒/动作的延迟实现了相比SignFlow 8.3倍、SOKE 26.1倍的加速；消融实验验证了运动表示(MR)、几何效率(GE)和自然度引导(NG)三个模块各自的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SignNMFlow通过在运动流形上直接构造同时兼顾几何效率和运动分布的条件路径，显著提升了手语生成的质量与保真度，为基于流匹配的SLP提供了新的流形传输视角。

title: QuPID: Quantum Parameter-Efficient Input-Dependent Retrieval Adaptation for Medical RAG
summary: Fidelity-based quantum retrieval ranks candidates by the fidelity between query and archive states. Applying a shared input-independent unitary after fixed state encoding leaves that fidelity unchanged, so training the circuit cannot alter the ranking. Quantum parameter-efficient input-dependent retrieval adaptation (QuPID) repairs this by making the circuit input-dependent through data re-uploading and by comparing measurement readouts, vectors of local Pauli expectations, rather than states. The result is a small readout for adapting frozen image features to a local archive with limited data: training simulates the circuit classically, and inference runs on a GPU with fixed learned parameters. We characterize the class as a structured factorization of input-modulated quadratic feature maps, bound the frequency support of its re-uploading channel, and give a parameter-count generalization bound that motivates its small budget. Under a shared frozen backbone and a label-free protocol, QuPID's 60 parameters give higher precision-at-5 (P@5) on ChestX-ray14 and MURA than frozen medical encoders, and than adapters and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with up to 5.25 million trainable parameters. On ChestX-ray14, the P@5 gain over the frozen encoder is +0.116, the lead over retuned adapters is widest at 512 adaptation examples (+0.040), and the full-budget margin over an equally compact classical rotation-plane head is +0.023 with a 95% interval excluding zero. Medical imaging is the primary testbed; the pattern recurs on two non-medical benchmarks, in report generation, and under simulated gate noise and finite-shot readout.

AI.tldr: QuPID 提出了一种用于医学 RAG 检索的量子参数高效输入依赖适配方法,仅用 60 个共享参数即可在 ChestX-ray14 和 MURA 上实现比 5.25M 参数的 Adapter 和 LoRA 更高的 P@5;其核心是通过数据重上传和测量读出替代基于状态保真度的相似度比较,以规避共享酉变换下的训练退化。
AI.motivation: 医学影像检索中,病理信息常被池化后的通用解剖特征淹没,导致相似病例在冻结特征空间中近似共线,引发诊断不一致的检索证据和 RAG 幻觉;且数据保护法规限制了数据外流,本地可用适配样本有限。因此需要一种参数极少、无需专家标注的检索几何适配方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三项关键设计:(1) 通过 Proposition 1 证明,冻结特征经过振幅编码后,共享输入无关酉变换下的保真度排序对参数不可训练,故该方法采用数据重上传使电路输入依赖;(2) 相似度不再比较量子态,而是比较局部 Pauli 期望读出向量 z ∈ R^40 的余弦;(3) 用 SimCLR 式对比损失进行无标签训练,理论分析给出读出的频谱上界(Proposition 2)和参数计数泛化界(Proposition 3)。电路仅 60 个共享参数(10 量子比特、3 层、4n_q 个观测)。
AI.result: 在 ChestX-ray14 和 MURA 上,QuPID 的 60 参数取得比最高 5.25M 参数 Adapter/LoRA 更高的 P@5;在 ChestX-ray14 上较冻结编码器提升 +0.116 P@5,512 适配样本时较重调 Adapter 优势最大(+0.040);在 IU X-Ray 和 MIMIC-CXR 的报告生成中,QuPID 的检索上下文使 CheXbert-F1 和 RadGraph-F1 优于 Adapter。在 MVTec AD 和 CUB-200 上同样观察到该模式。噪声模拟和有限采样读出表明排序质量在 10^4 shots 时与精确期望仅相差 0.002 P@5。
AI.conclusion: QuPID 验证了电路定义的测量特征是参数高效检索适配的可行路径,在仅 60 参数下达到或超过百万级参数 Adapter/LoRA 的检索质量;但其优势仅在经典 GPU 模拟下成立,不声称量子计算优势;在 512 适配样本下对等参数对照(rotation-plane head)的 95% 置信区间包含零。该方法适用于本地、低数据、参数极受限的检索适配场景。

title: Unmask the State: When Does State Adaptation Matter for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDMs) admit flexible generation orders, making the unmasking strategy an inference decision. Existing methods vary in how they prioritize positions, control parallelism, restrict selection regions, revise predictions, or plan future denoising, yet it remains unclear when these choices should change during generation. We study this question through strategy reversals, where an alternative action becomes preferable to a fixed choice. We organize MDM inference into five axes--score, cardinality, region, commitment, and planning--and define adaptation opportunity as the one-step utility advantage of the best candidate action over a validation-selected fixed action. This view shows that adaptation value depends on both the frequency and magnitude of such reversals. Across three MDMs and ten tasks, adaptation opportunities are highly heterogeneous, with some regimes exhibiting concentrated and predictable one-step gains. This motivates selective adaptation: lightweight detectors calibrated on validation prompts identify high-opportunity states, capturing, for example, 56.9 percent of the candidate-set oracle opportunity by adapting only the top 10 percent of states on LLaDA-8B constrained JSON filling. Our transition-level results suggest that state adaptation is most useful when applied selectively rather than uniformly.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对掩码扩散语言模型（MDM），系统研究了解码策略是否以及在多大程度上应根据当前状态（state）进行调整（即"状态自适应"）。作者将MDM推理决策组织为五个轴（得分、基数、区域、承诺、规划），提出"反转分解"理论刻画自适应机会的频率与幅度，并通过"选择性自适应"框架在三个MDM（LLaDA-8B、LLaDA-1.5、Dream-7B）和十项任务上的实验表明：自适应机会高度异质，固定动作在多数设置下具有竞争力，但特定场景（如结构化生成）存在可预测且集中的机会；轻量级验证校准检测器在有限覆盖下可捕获大部分oracle机会；端到端选择性自适应在所有三个模型上均优于最佳固定动作和始终自适应策略。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型支持灵活的生成顺序，但其推理策略空间庞大，现有方法在位置优先级、并行度、选择区域、预测修正、未来去噪规划等方面各有不同，但何时应改变策略选择尚不清晰。论文旨在回答"在哪些状态下，从固定策略切换到备选策略能带来收益，以及这种收益是否可预测"。
AI.method:
1. 提出五轴决策框架（score、region、cardinality、commitment、planning），将现有方法统一参数化。
2. 形式化"自适应机会"为最佳状态依赖动作相对于验证选定固定动作的一步效用优势。
3. 证明"反转分解定理"：自适应价值=反转频率×平均反转幅度。
4. 提出"选择性自适应"策略：轻量级验证校准检测器判断是否偏离固定动作，轴诊断器提供备选动作。
5. 设计训练免费的轴特定诊断器（基于回顾性排名证据、位置漂移、有向上下文传递、上下文价值与修订压力）。
6. 在三个MDM和十项任务上，通过单步迁移分析、机会检测评估和选择性解码评估进行验证。
AI.result:
1. 自适应机会高度异质：跨任务、模型、决策轴差异显著，LLaDA-8B间隙范围0.0025–0.0454，Dream最高达0.1325。
2. 机会分布集中：LLaDA-8B Constrained JSON Fill/region轴中，前10%状态包含56.9%的oracle机会（AUROC=0.854）；Dream Carry RTL/cardinality轴前10%捕获64.3%。
3. 选择性优于始终自适应：端到端任务宏效用从0.392提升至0.424（LLaDA-8B）、0.344至0.384（LLaDA-1.5）、0.411至0.467（Dream），而始终自适应在多数设置下降低性能。
4. 七组任务-模型-轴组合通过动作选择筛选，表明有效的轴特定自适应机制具有场景依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码扩散语言模型的状态自适应应选择性而非统一应用。固定动作在多数设置下保持竞争力；自适应机会的存在并不意味着可预测或可利用。论文通过五轴框架、反转分解和选择性自适应策略，提供了何时以及如何调整推理策略的实用指导，并强调了动作选择与机会检测分离的重要性。

title: Long-Horizon Analog Design Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hours-Long Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuit Design Tasks
summary: Coding agents now sustain hours-long, tool-driven loops, yet their ability to carry long-horizon analog and mixed-signal circuits to electrical specification remains unmeasured. We introduce Analog Design Bench, a long-horizon agentic benchmark of 50 transistor-level design tasks contributed by 17 chip designers. Agents work with an open-source simulator, while an isolated verifier evaluates the submitted circuit using specification-based electrical tests. We evaluate 15 agent configurations across 2,250 two-hour attempts and observe full-specification pass rates from 8.0% to 78.0%. Coding-benchmark performance correlates with analog results but leaves much of the performance spread unexplained. Our failure analysis shows that most unsuccessful submissions have no recorded legality rejection but fail electrical acceptance, identifying electrical closure as the dominant endpoint challenge. We test time, reasoning effort, agent harness, and supplied design knowledge as interventions. Longer budgets and higher reasoning effort improve performance, while general skill documents provide little benefit and sometimes reduce performance. Supplying a task-matched reference topology, an idealized form of circuit-IP retrieval, raises DeepSeek V4 Pro by 18.7 percentage points and mainly accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI.tldr: Analog Design Bench是一个面向长时间跨度（数小时）模拟与混合信号晶体管级电路设计任务的智能体基准测试，由17位芯片设计师贡献50个任务，使用开源SKY130 PDK与ngspice工具链及独立验证器。在15种智能体配置、2250次两小时尝试中，全规格通过率介于8.0%至78.0%。研究发现：电气规格达成是主要瓶颈（98.3%未通过尝试无合法性错误但电气不合格）；更长时间预算与更高推理努力可提升性能；通用技能文档收益有限，而提供任务匹配的参考拓扑可使DeepSeek V4 Pro提升18.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体已能在数小时级别的软件工程任务中维持工具调用循环，但其能否独立完成需要丰富专家知识与手动调优的模拟/混合信号电路设计仍未被系统衡量。该工作旨在填补通用编码智能体在前端模拟设计端到端能力评估方面的空白。
AI.method: 构建包含50个晶体管级任务的长程智能体基准。任务经20+设计师投稿、多轮审查与6种配置预筛选保留。使用SKY130 PDK与ngspice。智能体在沙盒中编辑、仿真电路，独立验证器执行合法性检查与基于规格的电气接受测试（每任务11至2083项条件级检查）。评估15种智能体配置（模型×推理努力×执行框架），每配置每任务3次回滚，并测试时间延长、推理努力、执行框架、设计技能文档及参考拓扑等干预。
AI.result: Claude Fable 5以78.0%通过率领跑（117/150），Claude Opus 5为69.3%，GPT-5.6 Sol为68.0%；其余11种配置均低于50%。每任务至少被某个配置解决一次，任务通过率介于4.4%至88.9%。仅1.1%尝试因合法性被拒，98.3%未通过尝试失败于电气规格。代码基准与模拟性能秩相关（ρ=0.88）但代码搜索分数无法解释大部分模拟性能差异。将时间从2小时延至6小时可提升14.0–20.0个百分点；高推理努力（Max/XHigh）在2小时后仍可继续提升；执行框架差异随时间收窄；通用技能文档收益小且不一致；提供任务匹配参考拓扑使DeepSeek V4 Pro提升18.7个百分点（2小时），主要加速GPT-5.6 Sol。
AI.conclusion: 该基准首次结合了专家贡献任务、多小时自主仿真与独立规格验证三项此前模拟基准未同时具备的特性。核心结论：(1) 代码搜索分数是模拟设计的不完整代理，电气闭合而非语法是主要终点挑战；(2) 更长时间与更高推理努力提升通过率，执行框架差异随时间收窄，通用技能文档收益有限；(3) 任务匹配参考拓扑（即理想化电路IP检索）带来显著收益，提示拓扑选择与网表构建是弱模型的主要瓶颈，而强模型主要受益于更快收敛。未来方向：电路库检索与自适应设计，以及更可靠的电气闭合（跨工况余量检查、保持已通过电路）。

title: DISCERN: Can AI Agents Work Like Scientists and Guide Discovery?
summary: Reliable automated research requires agents to vet data, verify analyses, and generate hypotheses grounded in trustworthy evidence, potentially reducing routine scientific workload while allowing scientists to focus on interpretation and discovery. Existing benchmarks often only assess analytical task completion or hypothesis generation separately rather than testing whether reliable evidence supports valid and novel claims. We introduce DISCERN (Data Integrity and Scientific Capability: Evidence, Reasoning, and Novelty), a controlled benchmark on real, publicly available datasets that evaluates three key levels of an automated research workflow. The first two levels test data integrity and analysis verification under confounds and tool traps, while the third tests hypothesis generation and revision under adversarial review, including counterfactual cases in which evidence consistent with real data and documented scientific phenomena conflicts with established expectations, motivating alternative explanations and testable hypotheses. Across 203 tasks, eight life-science tracks, and eight models, DISCERN shows that strong aggregate performance can mask level-specific weaknesses. Agents earn perfect scores in only 60.8% of Level 1, 34.2% of Level 2, and 0.6% of Level 3 evaluations, with penalties attributed to rejection of sound data, failure to carry recognized limitations into conclusions, and wide variation in hypothesis production. Cross-track rankings by token and code use are substantially more stable than rankings by evidence judgment, suggesting greater consistency in computational effort than in evidence-based reasoning. These profiles identify opportunities for supervised scientific assistance, but current agents do not yet demonstrate reliable autonomous analysis or discovery. Code and data: this https URL

AI.tldr: DISCERN是一个面向自动化科研工作流的三层级基准测试，涵盖203个任务、8个生命科学赛道，对8个主流大模型代理进行数据完整性、分析验证和假设生成能力的全面评估，揭示出尽管模型在聚合指标上表现良好，但在各层级尤其是假设生成层面存在显著且具体的薄弱环节。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试往往只单独评估分析任务完成度或假设生成能力，缺乏对"可靠证据是否支撑有效且新颖的科学声明"这一完整链条的端到端检验，掩盖了科研工作流中局部错误如何逐级传播并扭曲最终科学结论的脆弱性问题。
AI.method: 构建三层级受控基准：第一层（L1）79个数据预处理任务，包含干净对照组与受控数据缺陷；第二层（L2）102个分析验证任务，涵盖24个分析家族，包含数据混淆、工具陷阱与统计陷阱；第三层（L3）22个假设反论点，引入反事实证据并经三轮对抗性评审。最后在严格综述中扩展至物理领域（量热与核衰变）以检验跨领域迁移性。采用密封Python沙箱、共享提示与结构化报告范式，并由独立LLM验证器交叉核查确定性评分。
AI.result: 8个模型在203任务中：GPT-6 Astra聚合得分最高（78.1），但无模型在三层级全面领先；完美得分率L1为60.8%、L2为34.2%、L3仅0.6%；L3假设生成在46.9%的模型-赛道组合中为最弱环节；46.8%的提交假设未获得新颖性学分；识别问题与最终校准存在显著脱节；Fable覆盖不全（59.7%的L1/L2任务、9.1%的L3任务）。计算资源使用排名跨赛道高度稳定（W=0.89-0.95），而证据判断排名稳定性低（W=0.09-0.57）。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI代理展示了科学工作的有用组成部件，可支持受约束的研究任务，但在数据预处理、分析验证和假设生成全链条上的可靠性仍不均衡。科研能力是组合性的且依赖上下文，聚合得分不能反映统一的科学可靠性；进展需同时提升证据信任、结论校准、任务参与可预测性以及计算效率，以实现监督下可靠的科研辅助。

title: DrafTS: Time-Aware Decomposition with Residual Correction for Time Series Modeling
summary: Real-world time series contain evolving underlying dynamics with irregular variations that lack stable temporal patterns and are often referred to as noise. Existing methods address this mixture by filtering frequencies or suppressing noisy observations. They either miss temporal evolution or risk suppressing useful dynamics. We propose DrafTS, a model-agnostic framework that aims to reduce noise while preserving evolving dynamics through time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series. DrafTS uses features derived from instantaneous amplitude and frequency to guide decomposition into a primary component intended to capture underlying dynamics. A task-specific backbone models the primary component, while a lightweight correction module uses residual information to correct the backbone output. Across four time series modeling tasks, DrafTS improves six diverse backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出DrafTS框架，通过时序感知分解与残差校正解决时间序列中演化动态与噪声共存的问题，在四大任务上有效提升六类基线模型。
AI.motivation: 真实时间序列中演化动态与噪声共存，现有方法（频率滤波或观测抑制）易丢失时间演化或误抑制有用动态，亟需兼顾去噪与动态保留的新范式。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 时序感知分解——对输入进行EMD分解得到IMF，经Hilbert变换得到瞬时幅值与频率，提取四个解析特征（频率变化、幅值变化、解析创新、IMF阶数），映射为可学习的时序感知软掩码，分离主成分与残差；(2) 建模与校正——任务特定骨干网络建模主成分，基于固定储备池的轻量Residual-Aware Correction模块利用残差进行输出校正。
AI.result: 在短期/长期预测、分类、异常检测四大任务的多个基准数据集上，DrafTS均提升六类代表性骨干（Crossformer、PatchTST、iTransformer、TimeMixer、TimeFilter、L-Drive）。在Noisy Lorenz63合成数据集上对TimeMixer的MSE最高降低14.84%，分类任务上TimeMixer准确率从45.41%提升至53.12%，仅引入极少的额外参数与计算开销（参数量↑0.23%，FLOPs↑0.12%）。
AI.conclusion: DrafTS提出的时序感知分解与残差校正新范式能有效平衡去噪与动态保留，具有模型无关性，可广泛增强现有架构。未来将探索在线多变量分解以捕捉演化的跨变量动态。

title: Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising for Video Deepfake Detection
summary: The growing threat of video deepfakes necessitates multimodal detection. Beyond serving as independent indicators of authenticity, audio and visual signals have intrinsic dependencies that also provide an essential criterion for detection. Previous methods often overlook the cross-modal correspondences, hindering information transfer between domains and leaving crucial detection cues unexplored. To address this challenge, we propose a framework called Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD) for video deepfake detection. It connects the distinct distributions of heterogeneous modalities in latent spaces, enabling smooth cross-domain information transfer to improve detection performance. We first establish a Bayesian foundation by decomposing the audio-visual joint distribution. Subsequently, CTCLD translates both modalities via bidirectional latent denoising conditioned on each other, effectively capturing subtle inconsistencies in the manipulated signals. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CTCLD enables comprehensive domain alignment, resulting in a robust video deepfake detection approach with competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CTCLD的跨模态翻译框架，通过条件潜在去噪实现视频深伪检测。该方法基于贝叶斯分解建立音视频联合分布，通过双向潜在去噪过程实现跨模态信息对齐，在FakeAVCeleb和DFDC数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态深度伪造技术的发展，传统单模态检测方法难以应对。现有方法存在两个关键问题：(1)独立建模音视频流，忽略了模态间的内在依赖关系；(2)简单的跨模态映射导致信息退化，未能充分利用跨模态对应关系提供的关键检测线索。
AI.method:
1. **贝叶斯分解**：通过对称化贝叶斯分解将复杂的音视频联合分布p(z_A, z_V)分解为各模态边际分布与跨模态条件分布的组合。
2. **跨模态翻译**：设计双向条件潜在去噪机制——音频引导的视觉翻译模块Ψ^(A→V)将音频表示投影为视觉先验，视觉引导的音频翻译模块Ψ^(V→A)对称执行。
3. **条件潜在去噪**：基于扩散模型，以跨模态先验为条件，通过K个级联的扩散Transformer块（含自适应层归一化调制）进行去噪重建。
4. **检测融合**：将原始嵌入、跨模态先验、重建嵌入沿通道拼接，输入检测头输出伪造分数。
AI.result: 在FakeAVCeleb数据集上达到99.4% Acc和99.5% AUC，在DFDC数据集上达到98.5% Acc和99.9% AUC，均优于现有最优方法。消融实验证实双向翻译的必要性，t-SNE可视化显示真假样本分布清晰分离。敏感性分析表明损失权重λ=10⁻²、采样步数为5时性能最优。
AI.conclusion: CTCLD通过潜在空间中的跨模态翻译有效桥接异构模态，能够放大细微的音视觉不一致性，揭示深伪操纵痕迹。该生成式翻译范式有望启发更广泛的多模态信号处理应用。

title: CoViST: Visual Token Compression via Composable States
summary: Visual token compression lowers the inference cost of vision--language models by representing images with fewer tokens. However, most existing methods compress visual tokens to a reduced set, leaving the amount of visual evidence represented by each token and its original spatial context implicit. Therefore, the compressed representation does not explicitly encode how much visual information each representative carries or where it lies in the original image. This limitation arises even after a single reduction and becomes more pronounced when compression is repeated across decoder layers. To address this issue, we propose CoViST, a training-free framework that represents a compressed image as a composable visual state. Specifically, the state combines representative features with original positions, effective contribution weights, and reusable selection metadata. CoViST constructs this state through coverage-guided selection and conservation-based contribution composition, and explicitly incorporates its contribution and positional information into decoder attention. Each component of the state retains its interpretation under successive reductions, enabling the same formulation to support both fixed compression before prefill and progressive compression within the decoder. Experimental results on seven LLaVA-1.5-7B benchmarks show that CoViST-Fixed retains 99.9\%, 99.5\%, and 98.1\% of uncompressed performance at 192, 128, and 64 tokens, respectively, and CoViST-Pro retains 99.8\%, 99.9\%, and 99.1\% at the corresponding layer-average budgets, outperforming state-of-the-art methods under their respective budget settings. Code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoViST，一种无需训练的视觉令牌压缩框架，将压缩图像表示为可组合视觉状态，保留代表性特征、原始位置、有效贡献权重和可重用选择元数据，支持固定压缩和渐进式压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉令牌压缩方法将压缩后的视觉令牌简化为一个缩减集合，未明确编码每个代表性令牌所承载的视觉信息量及其在原始图像中的位置，这一限制在跨解码器层重复压缩时更为突出。
AI.method: CoViST框架包含三个模块：(1) 覆盖引导状态初始化(CSI)选择代表性令牌；(2) 耦合状态组合(CSC)在每图像守恒约束下转移被移除令牌的贡献，并跨阶段继承权重；(3) 状态调节注意力(SCA)将贡献权重和原始位置整合到解码器注意力中。提供两种执行策略：CoViST-Fixed在预填充前压缩至K个令牌；CoViST-Pro在解码器内渐进压缩。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B七个基准测试中，CoViST-Fixed在192、128、64个令牌时分别保留99.9%、99.5%、98.1%的未压缩性能；CoViST-Pro在相应层平均预算下分别保留99.8%、99.9%、99.1%。在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上实现最高达2.22×的推理加速，并泛化至LLaVA-1.5-13B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B。
AI.conclusion: CoViST通过可组合视觉状态显式编码信息重分配，在固定和渐进压缩两种策略下均达到当前最优的性能保留率，并能加速VLM推理，方法无需训练且可跨模型迁移。

title: COEVO: Co-Evolving Context and Parameters for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to move large language models beyond static training pipelines toward systems that can participate in improving their own future behavior. Existing approaches largely follow two directions: updating model parameters through online learning, or improving the external context through search, reflection, and prompt optimization. Although both mechanisms can support continued improvement, they are typically studied independently. This separation overlooks an important interaction: the context shapes the experience from which a model learns, while an evolving model may interpret and utilize the same context differently over time. We therefore formulate RSI as a problem of parameter--context co-evolution, where model parameters and the learning context adapt within a shared feedback loop. We introduce COEVO, a framework that updates model parameters from on-policy experience while adapting contextual guidance according to the state of the evolving policy. Policy entropy and prompt-conditioned attention are used as complementary signals to guide this adaptation. Experiments show that COEVO consistently improves task performance over fixed-context reinforcement learning and produces policies that are more robust to changes in system prompts. More broadly, our results suggest that external context should be viewed not merely as a fixed interface to a large language model, but as an adaptive component of recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COEVO框架，将大语言模型的递归自我改进（RSI）重新定义为参数与上下文的协同进化问题。该框架在共享反馈循环中同时更新模型参数（通过on-policy强化学习）和上下文策略支架（通过策略感知的编辑），使用策略熵（探索状态）和提示条件注意力（上下文利用）作为互补信号来引导上下文适应。
AI.motivation: 现有RSI方法主要沿两个独立方向研究：在线学习更新模型参数，或通过搜索/反思/提示优化改进外部上下文。这种分离忽视了关键交互作用——上下文塑造了模型学习的经验，而不断演化的模型会以不同方式解读和利用同一上下文。因此需要一种统一框架来协同进化这两个组件。
AI.method: COEVO采用GRPO风格的强化学习进行参数更新（使用LoRA），将系统提示分解为固定任务规范c和可编辑策略支架s_t。在每5个RL步骤后，冻结当前检查点，使用策略熵H_t（反映行为探索）和提示条件注意力U_{t,k}（反映各策略段利用率）将策略映射到四个干预区域：低/低=扩展（Expand）、低/高=放松（Relax）、高/低=澄清（Clarify）、高/高=巩固（Consolidate）。根据确定的干预方向，生成8个候选修订，在同一冻结检查点上评估，只有在策略状态朝预期方向移动且任务性能保持在容忍范围内的候选才会被接受。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B/4B-Base/9B/27B模型上评估数学推理（DAPO-Math-17k/AIME 2025）和代码生成（LiveCodeBench时间分割）任务。COEVO在所有规模和领域上始终优于固定提示GRPO基线。关键结果：4B-Math上COEVO达到44.17% Average@12和73.33% Pass@12（最差情况），Pass@12在三种推理提示下均为73.33%（零方差）；9B-Math达到65.56%/93.33%；9B-Code达到34.12%/55.67%。消融研究证实，仅使用注意力信号导致熵下降（过度集中），仅使用熵信号无法定位上下文利用问题；E-SPL风格的纯奖励驱动基线因过早利用而表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明外部上下文应被视为递归自我改进的自适应组成部分，而非固定接口。参数-上下文协同进化视角揭示了RLSI应理解为多个交互组件的协同演化：模型改进改变上下文使用方式，上下文变化重塑驱动学习的数据分布。在有界可控设置中研究此交互为分析更一般的自改进系统提供了基础。

title: MetaBench-Harness: Unlocking End-to-End Optimization of Benchmark Harnesses
summary: Rapid progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) is saturating static benchmarks faster than they can be designed. While existing automated evolution frameworks attempt to generate harder questions by perturbing individual tasks, they remain constrained by rigid, hard-coded generation rules. Moving beyond the evolution of isolated tasks, we propose to optimize the benchmark generation workflow itself end to end with MetaBench-Harness, a dual-loop search framework. Specifically, the inner loop utilizes a benchmark harness to generate a new benchmark in each round, while the outer meta-harness orchestration layer iteratively refines and searches over harness implementations based on historical evolution trajectories. By applying MetaBench-Harness to the competitive programming CodeContests and Olympiad mathematics AIME-2024 datasets, we demonstrate that the evolved benchmarks are challenging and discriminative for frontier models. Trajectory and quality analyses verify that MetaBench-Harness enables multi-dimensional evolution, steadily improving evolution reasonableness, benchmark competency, and evaluator robustness across successive rounds. Furthermore, case studies reveal its effective utilization of diverse difficulty levers to reframe problems and elevate required capabilities. Ultimately, this work provides a solution to the pressing challenge of benchmark saturation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaBench-Harness，一种双循环搜索框架，端到端优化基准生成工作流本身（而非单个任务），通过内循环生成基准、外循环基于历史轨迹迭代优化 harness 实现，在 CodeContests 和 AIME-2024 上验证可生成对前沿模型具有挑战性和区分性的进化基准。
AI.motivation: 静态基准因 LLM 快速进步而饱和，且现有自动进化方法受限于僵化的硬编码规则，无法真正提升任务复杂度，亟需超越孤立任务进化的端到端可进化基准生成框架。
AI.method: 双循环搜索框架：内循环使用可编辑的 harness 程序从种子生成基准（四阶段：场景发现→任务与评估器合成→模型验证→生命周期审计）；外循环由 LLM 代理通过"提议→评估→选择→应用"四步，基于未压缩的轨迹记忆迭代优化 harness 自身实现；优化目标为最大化代理模型间的分数差异并最小化平均性能；代理实现采用 Claude-Sonnet-5，代理模型为 Claude-Sonnet-5 与 GPT-5.4。
AI.result: 在 MB-CodeContests（10 轮）和 MB-AIME（5 轮）上，相比 Baseline、AutoEvoEval、TRACE、Naïve Prompting、Fixed Harness 等基线，显著降低前沿模型准确率（如 DeepSeek 从 0.900 降至 0.322，Qwen-7B 降至 0.044），同时保持强区分性；推理模型在进化后 MB-AIME 上仍维持 0.333-0.533 准确率；多维度质量（合理性/胜任力/鲁棒性）随轮次稳步提升，最终整体通过率达 70%。
AI.conclusion: MetaBench-Harness 通过同时进化基准与 harness 本身，有效解决静态基准饱和问题，案例研究表明系统能通过元层级偏移、复合约束、干扰项注入等多种难度杠杆多维度重构问题，是应对基准饱和的可行方案。

title: Temporal Graph Learning of Wearable Actigraphy and Sleep Traces for Modelling Adolescent Crystallized Intelligence
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems for possible publication
summary: Wearable actigraphy offers a scalable, ecologically valid alternative to episodic clinical assessment. However, predicting continuous adolescent crystallized intelligence ($G_c$) from such traces remains challenging due to irregular device adherence and complex behavioral-environmental interactions. We address this using daily summary data derived from 21-day Fitbit records of 6,091 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (Release 5.1). We propose SATURN, a Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network. It represents participants as 21-node temporal graphs encoding daily behaviors and temporal adjacency. To prevent imputation artifacts, invalid-day edges are dynamically pruned during forward passes. Node embeddings are refined via residual GATv2 layers, aggregated through masked attention pooling, and fused with sociodemographic covariates. Under family-controlled, age-sex-BMI-stratified cross-validation, SATURN achieves $R^2 = 0.2783 \pm 0.0127$, consistently improving upon flattened machine learning (Gradient Boosting, $R^2 = 0.2372$) and sequential deep learning (BiLSTM, $R^2 = 0.2688$) baselines. Explainability analyses identify light activity, metabolic equivalents, and sleep duration as dominant predictors, while Monte Carlo dropout and subgroup analyses confirm equitable performance across sociodemographic strata. Ultimately, SATURN establishes a rigorous computational framework for digital cognitive phenotyping, offering a scalable pathway to complement traditional assessments by highlighting macro-level behavioral anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SATURN模型，基于21天Fitbit可穿戴数据，通过21节点时序图与残差GATv2预测青少年晶体管家的Gc，R²=0.2783，优于扁平化机器学习和BiLSTM基线，并通过可解释性分析与子群体公平性验证了其稳健性。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备数据存在设备佩戴不规律、行为-环境交互复杂等问题，传统方法将其视为缺失噪声或简单插补，混淆了测量失败与真实低活动信号，无法从21天行为轨迹中提取与晶体管家的Gc相关的连续信号。
AI.method: 将每位参与者表示为21节点有向时序图（每天一节点，含自环的全连接基础图），边含5个时间属性；前向传播时基于有效性掩膜动态剪枝无效日边；节点经线性投影后通过两层残差GATv2（含可学习距离衰减通道）细化，采用掩膜注意力池化聚合，最后与人口统计学协变量融合经MLP回归头预测Gc；选用ABCD研究6091名青少年的21天Fitbit家动与睡眠数据，采用家庭感知分层交叉验证，并以置换特征重要性和Integrated Gradients进行可解释性分析，Monte Carlo Dropout估计认知不确定性。
AI.result: SATURN R²=0.2783±0.0127、r=0.5304±0.0104，优于梯度提升（R²=0.2372）与掩膜BiLSTM（R²=0.2688）；消融动态边剪枝降至R²=0.2735，去除协变量仅Fitbit输入R²=0.1221；轻体力活动、代谢当量、睡眠时长为主导预测因子；MC Dropout显示预测不确定性随Gc分布尾部上升；各子群体绝对误差均衡，但低教育组R²较低。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了SATURN框架，将缺失性视为信号的结构属性而非简单噪声，通过时序图动态剪枝有效保留可穿戴行为信号，为数字认知表型分析提供了可扩展、可解释且公平的计算基础，为传统临床认知评估提供宏观行为异常的辅助筛分层。

title: APEX: An Extensible Model for Agent-Assisted Production Scheduling
summary: Production scheduling requires realistic models that reflect operational constraints and efficient methods that balance competing goals. Putting these methods into use also requires data integration, model adaptation and specialist expertise. We present APEX, an extensible production scheduling framework built around a general model and hybrid multiobjective search. Agent assistance supports both scheduling and model refinement: agents prepare data and explore scenarios in natural language, while coding agents help implement and test new constraints and objectives. Shared construction and checking procedures connect these adaptations to the scheduling core. We benchmark eight APEX configurations against NSGA-II, SPEA2, MOEA/D and SMS-EMOA on 69 public job-shop, flexible job-shop and permutation flow-shop instances, assessing workload completion time (makespan), total job flowtime and computation time. Hybrid configurations achieve the best aggregate solution quality, although the leading method depends on the problem class and objective. A separate synthetic workflow study uses OpenAI's GPT-6-astra as an interaction layer between the human planner and the algorithmic core, testing rule additions, plan and objective changes, and what-if comparisons. All 24 sessions completed the requested changes and passed independent checks of saved models and schedules. A separate coding evaluation produced six native implementations of an additional objective or hard constraint through predefined extension hooks. All passed independent checks without modifying the core.

AI.tldr: APEX是一个面向生产调度的可扩展框架，集成通用模型与混合多目标搜索（XG/XH/XT/XE四种组件），并通过LLM智能体支持规划操作与模型扩展。在69个公开JSP/FJSP/PFSP实例上对八种APEX配置与NSGA-II、SPEA2、MOEA/D、SMS-EMOA进行基准测试；通过GPT-6-astra进行智能体辅助工作流与原生代码扩展实验。
AI.motivation: 实际生产调度需要既反映运营约束的模型，又需高效的多目标搜索算法；但将方法投入使用还涉及数据集成、模型适配和专家知识。现有APS系统部署成本高，且常因模型与车间状态脱节而需人工干预。此外，固定抽象层内的算法优化无法保证抽象层本身能捕获决定可行性的车间约束。因此需要一个可扩展的统一模型、共享评估路径的搜索组件，以及能够支持配置和模型扩展的智能体辅助机制。
AI.method: 模型层：扩展FJSP，引入多阶段操作、可选工艺路线、机器/人员/工装多资源、分阶段日历、序列相关准备/收尾活动、材料供需与分配、剩余工作量再规划、固定承诺与冻结范围、强制构造策略。通过统一评估路径连接搜索组件。搜索层：四种组件共享构造/评估/验证语义——XG（贪婪构造）、XH（超启发式策略搜索，NSGA-II风格Pareto选择）、XT（UCT前缀树搜索）、XE（操作优先级排列+模式/路线/条件活动的直接调度进化，使用折扣UCB算子分配）。支持组合（XHT/XHE/XTE/XHTE）。外部对比算法使用pymoo库的NSGA-II、SPEA2、MOEA/D、SMS-EMOA，配备离散解码器。评估方式：在69个公开实例（19 JSP + 32 FJSP + 18 PFSP）上以1000次候选评估预算、三种随机种子（19/42/73），比较超体积赤字、makespan/flowtime差距与运行时间。智能体实验：(1) GPT-6-astra作为人机交互层，在8种×3上下文的24次会话中测试规则添加、计划承诺、目标变更与情景对比；(2) 7次编码会话通过预定义钩子实现新的平方延迟目标与硬约束暴露平衡规则，由独立检查器验证。
AI.result: 计算结果：XHTE与XHE在69实例上的总体超体积赤字最小（分别为0.457%和0.466%）；XHTE在makespan差距上最优（1.717%），XHE在flowtime差距上最优（3.053%）且运行时间较短（30.1s vs 33.1s）。外部算法中MOEA/D最优（2.248%），但APEX混合配置在所有质量指标上均优于外部算法。问题类差异显著：JSP上XHT最优（HV赤字0.192%），FJSP上XH最优（0.171%），PFSP上MOEA/D最优（0.276%）且XE是APEX最佳配置（0.343%）。XG单次构造仅需0.035s，质量较低。外部算法运行时间比APEX快约50倍（0.5-0.7s vs 30-40s）。智能体工作流实验：所有24次配置与规划会话通过独立检查；6次原生实现（3个目标+3个约束）全部通过独立验证且未修改核心代码。
AI.conclusion: APEX将互补搜索方法与面向工业规划需求的生产模型相结合，混合多目标配置在经典基准上取得最优综合质量，但最优组件依赖问题类别：JSP偏好策略搜索组合，FJSP偏好策略搜索本身，PFSP则偏好MOEA/D或独立XE。组件选择应基于问题结构而非默认使用最长组合。外部实现运行时间显著更短，因此运行时间改进与匹配时间比较是后续工作重点。智能体能正确操作现有模型并通过预定义钩子实现新目标与硬约束，所有扩展通过独立验证且核心代码未变。总体贡献在于通用可扩展生产模型与快速调度构造和智能体辅助使用与精化的结合。下一步工作是蒙特卡洛仿真评估以及实际车间的现场研究，包括"释放生产计划"与"批准模型变更"两类不同审批流程的组织设计。

title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
summary: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, \emph{The Harness of Harnesses}, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an \emph{All-Domain Collaboration Network}, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.

AI.tldr: Raven提出"harness of harnesses"范式,将可执行模型-harness对作为可组合智能单元,通过Host Agent协调异构智能体、模块化harness自演化、持久记忆和Skill Forge实现跨域长任务协作,并建立可组合智能的形式化理论,在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 随着AI agent从单域任务向长程跨域工作流演进,手动设计harness的可扩展性受限,单一harness的域耦合限制了其通用性。核心问题从"如何为一个域设计更强harness"转变为"如何自动构建、改进并跨域编排专业化harness"。
AI.method: 核心架构包括:(1)Host Agent将目标分解为DAG,匹配子任务到注册智能体,协调执行依赖;(2)模块化harness自演化(HarnessBank方法)通过诊断失败、生成候选、门控筛选实现固定模型下的策略改进;(3)EverOS记忆系统分离episodic trace、semantic consolidation和检索;(4)Skill Forge融合本地、记忆和SkillHub技能,通过RRF融合和LLM门控选择可复用程序。理论上,建立了composable agentic intelligence的形式化框架,证明在互补局部能力、兼容交接和有界错误条件下,组合系统的可靠任务覆盖可超过任意单体智能体。
AI.result: 在MAOB多智能体编排基准上,Raven在两个backbone下均排名第一,Exact Match较最强基线分别提升10.4和10.5个百分点;Raven-Research在DeepResearch Mixed上以76.5%准确率领先;Raven-Code在SWE-Refactor上超出基线9.5分;Raven-Oncall在AI4AI上以更低成本达到更优BPB;技能检索在SkillsBench上带来+7.5±2.3点的提升。
AI.conclusion: Raven通过将模型-harness对作为可组合单元,成功实现异构智能体的跨域编排,理论分析证明组合可扩展可靠任务覆盖。实验验证了在规划、专家执行、harness适配和技能复用各层面的优势。未来工作将构建连接多设备的"All-Domain Collaboration Network",实现持久AI助手。

title: MAC-Net: A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Modeling Cognitive Function From Task-Based fMRI
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 supplementary tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering for possible publication
summary: Objective cognitive assessment from neural signals supports neurorehabilitation, but individual-level prediction from task-based fMRI (tfMRI) remains difficult because neural features coexist with substantial demographic and scanner-related variation. We present the Multi-task Activation and Contrast Network (MAC-Net), a covariate-aware deep learning framework for modeling individual cognitive function from regional tfMRI. By isolating tfMRI features into a dedicated neural pathway and restricting participant variables to a terminal late-fusion pathway, MAC-Net prevents dominant covariates from suppressing high-dimensional clinical representations during feature learning. Evaluating baseline data from 6,500 Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study participants under family-aware cross-validation, MAC-Net was benchmarked against linear models, random forests, and alternative deep architectures. The N-back plus Monetary Incentive Delay configuration achieved $R^{2}$ values of 0.174, 0.238, and 0.277 for fluid, crystallized, and total cognition, outperforming covariate-only baselines (0.178) and alternative deep models (0.217). N-back was the most informative paradigm, whereas incorporating the Stop Signal Task marginally degraded performance. Feature attributions via Integrated Gradients, DeepLIFT, and Input Gradient were highly concordant, localizing working-memory-related frontal, parietal, and cingulate regions. These findings demonstrate that covariate-aware multi-task modeling yields reproducible cognitive-function estimations, establishing a robust neural engineering framework for clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAC-Net（Multi-task Activation and Contrast Network），一种协变量感知的多任务深度学习框架，用于从任务态fMRI（tfMRI）的区域激活中建模个体认知功能。核心创新在于通过结构化的晚期融合（late-fusion）将tfMRI特征与人口学/采集协变量分离，防止协变量在高维特征学习阶段压制神经信号表征。在ABCD研究的6,500名青少年基线数据上，采用家族感知交叉验证，MAC-Net在流体智力、晶体智力和总认知得分上分别达到R²=0.174、0.238、0.277，优于正则化线性模型和多种深度学习架构。N-back为最具信息量的任务范式；多方法归因分析（Integrated Gradients、DeepLIFT、Input×Gradient）高度一致，定位于工作记忆相关的前额叶-顶叶-扣带回网络。
AI.motivation: 任务态fMRI的个体认知功能预测面临三大核心挑战：(1) 神经特征与显著的人口学及扫描仪相关变异共存，协变量可能在高维特征学习中压制临床相关表征；(2) 高维tfMRI数据需要灵活的非线性整合，但深度学习架构的复杂性并不必然带来性能提升，需要直接的架构基准对比；(3) 模型解释性方面，单一归因方法的结果高度依赖于算法选择、参考基线和特征相关性，需多方法一致性验证。这些挑战在ABCD等多中心发育队列中尤为突出，制约了神经工程框架的临床转化。
AI.method: MAC-Net采用双通路设计：(1) tfMRI通路——将94个脑区×C个条件的区域beta估计投影至64维嵌入空间，经三层前馈骨干网络（256→128→64神经元）处理，逐层使用1D批归一化、SiLU激活和Dropout（p=0.7）；(2) 协变量通路——年龄、性别、扫描仪、颅内体积（eTIV）和任务匹配的头动参数在终端读出层通过拼接实现晚期融合。使用AdamW优化器（lr=8.7×10⁻⁴, weight decay=5×10⁻³），ReduceLROnPlateau调度器，early stopping（patience=30）。三种NIH Toolbox认知目标（流体Gf、晶体Gc、总认知Gt）在家族感知五折交叉验证下评估。基准对比包括Ridge/Lasso/ElasticNet/Random Forest及SpatialGATNet、Tabular Transformer、Gated Tabular Network三种先进深度模型。
AI.result: N-back+MID主配置下，MAC-Net取得R²=0.174（Gf）、0.238（Gc）、0.277（Gt），优于最强协变量基线（R²=0.178，Gt）和最强替代深度模型Gated Tabular Network（R²=0.217，Gt）。单任务分析显示N-back最具信息量（R²=0.178/0.223/0.269），MID中等，SST最低；加入SST导致边际性能下降（维度灾难）。脑区仅消融（去除协变量）下MAC-Net仍超过随机森林协变量基线，证明tfMRI具有独立预测力。归因分析中三种方法Spearman相关性>0.996，最高排名特征集中于N-back 2-back vs 0-back对比，涉及左侧尾中额回、左侧三角部、喙/尾前扣带回及右侧顶下/顶上区，吻合工作记忆的额-顶网络。
AI.conclusion: MAC-Net建立了泄漏抵抗、可解释的认知功能估计计算框架。其晚期融合设计有效提取了超越人口学混杂的增量神经信号；多任务整合对晶体智力和总认知收益更显著；多方法归因一致性证实了模型对生物学合理网络的依赖。本研究为神经工程应用提供了方法论基础，未来需要在神经损伤和康复群体中进行多站点验证及纵向测试以推动临床部署。研究局限包括横断面基线数据、缺乏配对统计检验、完全病例分析可能引入选择偏差、图谱平均丢失空间细节，以及晚期健康后设计仅控制信息流而非统计去混杂。

title: What Shared Prefixes Hide: Trajectory Dropout for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own trajectories using dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher model. Since each update is conditioned on the reasoning prefix already generated by the student, the prefix also shapes how effectively teacher feedback is converted into learning. We find that shared prefixes can lead to weak token-level updates, a phenomenon we call Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation (PISA). This attenuation arises in two common cases. (i) High student confidence can weaken corrective gradients even when the teacher disagrees. (ii) Tokens that rely on earlier reasoning can receive learning signals as weak as those for simple local continuations. To solve this problem, we propose Trajectory Dropout, a simple training-time intervention that exposes these weakened signals. The student first performs a standard full-context rollout to generate a complete trajectory. During training, we randomly drop a certain proportion of the student's reasoning trajectory, while the teacher continues to observe the complete trajectory for token-level supervision. This intervention strengthens corrections for overconfident predictions and introduces additional supervision at prefix-sensitive positions. Trajectory Dropout consistently improves average performance across teacher--student model pairs of different scales and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while also yielding gains on two out-of-domain benchmarks. It can also be flexibly integrated into existing OPD variants with negligible computational overhead, further improving their performance. These results demonstrate that Trajectory Dropout provides a simple mechanism for strengthening token-level supervision across model scales and OPD objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 中"密集监督≠密集学习信号"的问题，识别出共享前缀导致的监督衰减现象 PISA（Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation），并提出简单干预方法 Trajectory Dropout (TD)：在保持完整上下文 rollout 与教师全前缀监督不变的前提下，对学生训练时的前缀访问进行随机掩码，从而暴露被弱化的 token 级学习信号。
AI.motivation: 在 OPD 中，学生基于自身采样轨迹进行密集 token 级蒸馏，但约 70% 的监督 token 贡献的 own-logit 信号质量不足 0.5%。作者诊断发现这是"前缀诱导监督衰减"（PISA）造成的两种饱和：(i) 置信饱和——学生过度自信使自身 token 梯度 (1−q) 趋于零，纠正信号被压制；(ii) 一致饱和——近零优势下，原本依赖远距离推理的前缀敏感位置与简单的局部续写被混在一起，丢失监督。动机是通过可控的前缀干预暴露这些被弱化的学习机会。
AI.method: 提出 Trajectory Dropout (TD)：(1) 学生先以全上下文自回归解码生成完整轨迹并保存；(2) 训练阶段随机采样连续跨度的响应 span（占比 ρ=0.2，1–8 个 span），生成固定注意力掩码 M；(3) 教师始终在完整因果前缀 h_t 上打分 p_t；(4) 学生以同一掩码 M 重放轨迹得到 r_{θ,t}；(5) 用 masked 视图概率替代目标函数中的学生侧得分，得到 L_TD。文中同时推导：(a) 对高置信位置，若掩码使 r_t 下降但仍大于 p_t，可通过函数 F_p(v)=(1−v)log(v/p) 的单调递减性质保证下向纠正更强；(b) 对近一致位置，mask 引入的额外优势 δ_t=log q_t−log r_t 作为敏感度信号，将原本不可区分的位置区分开来；(6) 引入可选的保护窗口 w，保持被掩 span 邻近 w 个位置仍可直接注意力。此外，加入教师消融、跨度粒度消融、norm 匹配对照实验以及 Huber 优势裁剪等分析。
AI.result: 主要实验使用 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 作为教师，学生为 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Qwen3-0.6B（非思考模式），训练数据为 DAPO-Math-17K 教师正确英文子集。结果：在六个数学推理基准（AIME24/25/26、OlympiadBench、HMMT Feb26/Nov25）上，TD-OPD 使 OPD 平均从 28.27 提升至 32.78（+4.5 pp，相对 +15.9%）；Fast-OPD 从 29.48 提升至 33.76（+14.6%），TRD 从 18.76 提升至 22.68（+20.9%）。思考模式下 OPD+TD 从 45.40 提升至 47.29。0.6B 学生也呈现一致提升。MBPP+ 与 GPQA Diamond 上有小幅提升。诊断显示 R_I∪R_II 区域在掩码下信号份额从约 0.48% 提升至 17–23%，约 45–50% 的弱信号 token 获得正增益。Norm 控制对照（半径 1.0×）显示在相同更新范数下，TD 更新带来 +0.027 的验证 KL 降低（p<0.001），证明优势源于方向而非步长；通道分解表明只有同时改变计算图与 loss 视角才会产生增益。计算开销仅 +2.8% 每步。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明在 OPD 训练时对学生前缀进行受控随机掩码（Trajectory Dropout），能够在不改变采样分布和教师监督的前提下，强化高置信位置的下行纠正信号，并区分近一致区域中真正依赖前缀推理的位置。TD 可作为插件无缝整合到现有 OPD 变体中，仅带来极小计算开销，在不同规模与不同 OPD 目标上稳定提升性能。消融表明保护窗口与中等掩码率（ρ≈0.2）对训练稳定性至关重要，norm 匹配分析验证增益来自更优更新方向而非更大步长。

title: When Does the Concept of "Dog" Emerge in an Audio LLM?
summary: Multimodal large language models answer audio questions, but how they represent auditory semantics and use them in decisions remains unclear, limiting our understanding of response formation. We study dog barking in Qwen2.5-Omni-7B using Jacobian lens (J-lens) readout and directional interventions. We define the dog direction as a J-lens-derived hidden-state vector associated with dog; adding or removing its component modulates dog-related information. We find this information decodable without dog/bark prompt cues or animal-identification requirements. Directional interventions change response tendencies and some final answers, with effects concentrated in late-layer states immediately before generation across species classification, vocalization classification, and sound description. The dog direction shows no comparable advantage over controls in animal/other classification. These results provide causal-intervention evidence that the dog direction affects output scores in a task-dependent manner, most consistently at L22 and L24 immediately before generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Qwen2.5-Omni-7B音频大语言模型中"狗"概念的内部表征与功能作用。通过Jacobian lens (J-lens)读出和方向性干预（消融、注入、交换），发现狗相关信息在不需要动物识别提示的任务中也可解码，且干预狗方向会改变输出分数和部分最终答案，效应集中在生成前的L22和L24晚期层状态，但这种优势在动物/非动物分类中不存在，表明其作用具有任务依赖性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型能回答音频问题，但其内部如何表征听觉语义并用于决策尚不清楚，这限制了对响应生成机制的理解。已有方法（如线性探针）仅测试可解码性，无法证明表征在答案生成中是否被实际使用。需要结合读出与因果干预来揭示音频概念在内部表征中的位置和功能。
AI.method: 采用J-lens（基于跨层Jacobian将中间状态映射到公共晚期表示空间）进行概念读出，定义"狗方向"为与dog token关联的隐藏状态向量。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B的Thinker组件上对狗吠录音（来自DogSpeak）、猫叫声和其他声音进行七项任务测试。使用方向性干预（消融β、注入α、交换γ）与范数匹配的vehicle和随机正交控制方向对比，通过AUC、读出分数差异Δ_read、输出logit变化Δ_I、答案转换率等指标评估，并进行bootstrap置信区间和BH校正的置换检验。定位分析比较L16-L24不同层和音频中间/末尾/后音频/决策位置的效应。
AI.result: 1) J-lens映射验证：L24处映射状态与实际L26状态的余弦相似度达0.820，输出头top-1一致率98.5%。2) 概念读出：L24处dog AUC=0.937，bark AUC=0.872，无需dog/bark提示也可区分狗与非狗录音（fixed-response AUC 0.873）。3) 干预效应在L0和L8接近零，从L20开始增大，L24最显著；L24消融使dog logit平均降低2.806，注入使其增加1.279，交换使dog-cat差异变化约±4.8。4) β=2比β=1产生更多dog→非dog转换（53/191 vs 14/191）；α=0.06注入产生20/180的other→dog转换，远超vehicle控制（0/180）和随机正交控制（1/180）；γ=1.5交换产生93/191的dog→cat转换。5) 定位分析：L22和L24决策位置处8项任务-操作比较中6项满足支持标准（物种分类、发声分类、声音描述），但动物/其他分类无对应优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了因果干预证据，证明"狗方向"对模型输出分数的影响具有任务依赖性。狗相关信息在无明确类别提示时即可解码；干预该方向能改变输出分数和部分最终答案；效应在L22和L24生成前位置最一致；在物种分类、发声分类和声音描述中产生预期方向的分数变化且优于控制，但在超层级动物/其他判断中无此优势。结合读出与受控干预将隐藏状态信息与答案变化联系起来，跨任务、层和位置的比较阐明了效应最一致的位置及其对任务要求的依赖性。

title: LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in financial decision-making, yet existing evaluations focus on equity trading and primarily assess directional prediction, overlooking the structural complexity of derivative markets. Option trading introduces fundamentally different challenges, including nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction, requiring structured decisions rather than simple directional bets. We introduce LiveOption, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in option trading. LiveOption formulates the problem as structured sequential decision-making under realistic execution and capital constraints, and provides a reproducible environment with standardized interaction protocols. The framework includes three task suites covering portfolio overlays, event-driven earnings trading, and 0DTE intraday trading. We further propose a hierarchical metric suite that evaluates action validity, decision quality, risk characteristics, and outcome-level performance. Experiments show that current agents often fail to achieve competitive returns in most scenarios. LiveOption offers a principled testbed for evaluating structured decision-making beyond outcome-based metrics.

AI.tldr: LiveOption是首个面向LLM期权交易智能体的系统性评估框架与基准，将期权交易建模为在现实执行与资本约束下的结构化序列决策问题，涵盖组合覆盖、事件驱动收益交易和0DTE日内交易三个任务套件，并提出分层评估指标。实验发现当前主流LLM智能体在大多数场景下均无法获得有竞争力的回报，揭示了其在期权市场中处理非线性收益、多腿策略与风险归因方面的系统性局限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM金融智能体评估主要集中于股票等线性收益资产，仅评估方向性预测能力，未涉及衍生品市场的结构性复杂性。期权交易具有非线性收益、多腿策略组合、多维风险敞口（Greeks）等独特挑战，亟需一个能够公平、可复现地评估LLM智能体在结构性决策任务中表现的基准框架。
AI.method: LiveOption将期权交易建模为结构化序列决策问题，采用analyzer-executor范式。核心设计包括：(1) 紧凑波动率表征AVSR（3×3锚点网格）；(2) 量化动作空间QOCR（按moneyness与到期分桶）；(3) 后端订单验证层。框架由四大组件构成：实时环境、多智能体系统、回测引擎与分层评估套件。三个任务场景分别为：组合覆盖策略（对冲与备兑看涨）、财报事件驱动交易（24只个股95个事件）、0DTE日内交易（SPY 102个周三/周五）。评估采用绝对绩效指标（AR、SR、MDD）和相对指标（ΔRet、IR），辅以行为分析（策略组合、方向vs结构推理、仓位与杠杆控制）和BSM-Greek PnL归因分解。实验评估6个LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GPT-OSS-120B、Qwen3-235B-A22B、Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、MiniMax-M3、GLM-5.3-Flash），2025年全年数据，进行684次消融实验。
AI.result: 主要结果显示：(1) 组合覆盖场景中，所有模型对冲下与5/6模型备兑看涨下的主动回报均为负，无模型在风险调整后跑赢被动持有；(2) 财报场景中，所有模型均值与中值收益均为负，Profit Factor低于1，仅MiniMax-M3的bootstrap区间排除零；(3) 0DTE场景中，均值收益从-0.73%到+0.14%，但考虑真实半价差成本后所有模型均为负，池化均值从-0.216pp变为-0.452pp（p=0.013）；(4) 无模型间差异在多重比较校正后统计显著；(5) 行为分析显示不同模型在交易频率、期限选择、策略结构组合上存在显著差异；(6) 消融实验表明移除投资组合状态使平均最大回撤从4.4%升至12.4%，移除Greeks使某模型无交易率达95.8%。整体结论是当前LLM智能体在期权交易中普遍缺乏竞争优势，但行为模式可通过干预性实验区分。
AI.conclusion: LiveOption提供了首个面向LLM期权交易智能体的系统性评估基准，揭示了当前LLM在处理非线性收益与结构化决策方面的系统性局限。研究表明：(1) 执行层风险验证应被视为基础设施而非提示工程；(2) 报告应包含参与率与尾部风险而非仅回报均值；(3) 信息依赖性应通过干预实验而非结果推断来测试。该框架为未来更可靠、更透明的金融智能体研究奠定了基础。

title: Just Let Linear States Forget the Distant Past: Prefix Caching via Suffix Replay for Hybrid LLMs
summary: Hybrid LLMs interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce long-context inference cost, but this structure complicates prefix caching. Full-attention KV caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing systems materialize recurrent-state checkpoints, restricting prefix reuse to checkpoint-aligned positions. We present SuffixReplay, the first prefix caching system that lets hybrid LLMs reuse cached prefixes at every cache-supported page boundary without materializing recurrent-state checkpoints. Our key insight is to just let linear states forget the distant past. Modern linear-attention mechanisms use recurrent decay and gating to attenuate the influence of old inputs. Therefore, instead of checkpointing every prefix boundary, SuffixReplay approximates the state at a matched boundary by replaying only a recent suffix of the layer's input hidden states, which we retain as anchors. At the algorithmic level, SuffixReplay combines layer-wise and token-wise anchor sparsity with a bounded replay budget to control storage, computation, and quality. At the system level, it uses an independently managed anchor sidecar and a pipelined replay path to overlap anchor movement and state reconstruction with the native serving pipeline. We evaluate SuffixReplay on three hybrid LLMs: OLMo-Hybrid-7B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.6-27B-FP8. Across these models, SuffixReplay retains 91.4-100% of full-prefill quality on average across LongBench and RULER, while using only 0.36-0.51x the amortized per-token storage of SGLang's default 8192-token checkpoint cache. Integrated into SGLang, SuffixReplay reduces median TTFT by 15-70% on branching workloads, sustains 2.3-4.3x SGLang's throughput when the working set exceeds HBM, and matches SGLang on high-hit continuation traffic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SuffixReplay系统，是首个针对混合大模型（混合全注意力层与线性注意力层）的细粒度前缀缓存方案。核心思想是利用现代线性注意力机制的衰减与门控特性（即"让线性状态遗忘久远的过去"），通过在分组入口处稀疏存储隐藏状态作为锚点（anchor），在缓存命中时仅重放（replay）最近的k个锚点即可近似重建线性注意力状态，从而无需在每个可能前缀边界物化循环状态检查点（checkpoint），实现了与全注意力模型相同的逐页边界前缀复用粒度。在算法层面，通过层级与token级稀疏锚点控制存储与计算；在系统层面，通过独立的锚点旁车（sidecar）与流水线化重放路径，与原生推理管线并行执行。在三个混合模型（OLMo-Hybrid-7B、Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B-FP8）上，相对完整prefill保留91.4-100%的质量，额外存储仅为SGLang默认8192-token检查点缓存的0.36-0.51倍；集成进SGLang后，分支工作负载中位TTFT降低15-70%，工作集超出HBM时吞吐达SGLang的2.3-4.3倍，高命中率续接流量下与SGLang持平。
AI.motivation: 混合LLM通过在全注意力层中交错线性注意力层来降低长上下文推理成本，但现有前缀缓存方案（如Marconi、SGLang、SparsePrefix）只能在物化的循环状态检查点位置恢复混合请求，导致前缀复用粒度受限——缓存命中只能发生在检查点对齐的边界。直接加密检查点又因单token检查点（约49 MiB）远大于单token KV缓存（约32 KiB，约1500倍）而代价高昂，无法实现FA模型那样的逐token或逐页边界连续前缀复用。
AI.method: SuffixReplay采用算法-系统协同设计。算法层面：(1)层级稀疏锚点——将连续线性注意力层分组，仅在每组入口处存储隐藏状态作为锚点，重放时只执行组内的线性注意力计算；(2)Token级稀疏锚点——仅在页面边界附近以密度ρ=1/16保留锚点，并采用密集采样布局；(3)有界重放预算——k = min(0.05n, k_max)个锚点，利用线性注意力自身的衰减门控机制，使重放状态S'_j ≈ S_j。系统层面：(1)锚点旁车（sidecar）——每个锚点块与对应KV页附在同一radix树节点并共享生命周期，但使用独立存储池与放置策略；(2)流水线化重放路径——锚点传输与KV回填并行，CUDA图在图中完成锚点写入避免主机同步；(3)批处理重放与按桶预捕获的重放图；(4)多轮请求边界处的活跃状态快路径。
AI.result: 在三个混合LLM上，SuffixReplay相对完整prefill在LongBench与RULER上平均保留91.4-100%质量（OLMo-Hybrid-7B需k=512，Qwen模型仅需k=128即可达标）；额外存储仅为SGLang默认8192-token检查点缓存的0.36-0.51倍；分支工作负载（ShareGPT、ToolMind、SWE-rebench）中位TTFT降低15-70%；分支落在检查点间隙时TTFT降低最高达5.1倍；高命中率agent续接场景下吞吐匹配或略超SGLang（+2.7%-+6.5%）；工作集超出HBM时维持0.85命中率，吞吐达SGLang的2.3-4.3倍。LooGLE（4.6M tokens）下命中率达0.62 vs SGLang 0.35，中位TTFT 53-159 ms vs 426-1307 ms。
AI.conclusion: SuffixReplay是首个无需在每个可能前缀边界物化循环状态检查点，即可在混合LLM上实现与FA模型同等逐页边界前缀复用粒度的系统。其核心洞察是：现代线性注意力机制的衰减与门控特性使得可通过保留稀疏的隐藏状态锚点并在命中时重放短后缀来精确重建状态，且额外存储、重放计算与质量三者可通过分层与token级稀疏性联合控制。在集成进SGLang后，分支延迟、容量上限与续接吞吐量均获得显著改善，为混合LLM的高效服务提供了实用解决方案。

title: Federated Multi-Modal Human Activity Recognition using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from heterogeneous wearable sensors is fundamental to the Internet of Health Things (IoHT), supporting rehabilitation, elderly care, and smart healthcare. Existing multimodal fusion methods often assign fixed equal weights to sensor streams, overlooking differences in modality importance, acquisition cost, and sensor quality, which can vary due to movement, incorrect placement, or temporary blockage. We propose an adaptive and cost-aware multimodal HAR framework based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for centralized HAR and extend it to federated learning as FedMHAR. In the centralized setting, multimodal fusion is formulated as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem, where each sensing modality is assigned a PPO-based agent that learns per-sample fusion weights, enabling the model to emphasize informative modalities while down-weighting costly sensors when cheaper alternatives provide sufficient information. In the federated setting, we introduce BiFL-PPO, a bidirectional federated optimization strategy in which a server-side PPO policy learns client-specific trust weights and feeds them back to adapt local learning rates and proximal regularization. Unlike round-level optimization, BiFL-PPO uses dense batch-level rewards for more frequent feedback and stable training under heterogeneous client data. Evaluation on the MEx Rehabilitation and UTD Multimodal Human Action datasets shows that the centralized framework achieves 87.30% and 94.98% accuracy, respectively, outperforming conventional fusion methods and state-of-the-art HAR models. FedMHAR achieves 79.74% and 77.49% in the federated setting, consistently surpassing FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, FedNova, and AdaFedProx, while providing more stable performance and reducing sensor acquisition cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的自适应、成本感知的多模态人类活动识别（HAR）框架，集中式版本采用PPO智能体学习逐样本融合权重，并引入FedMHAR联邦扩展（BiFL-PPO策略）实现客户端信任权重学习与双向反馈。在MEx和UTD-MHAD数据集上分别达到87.30%/94.98%（集中式）和79.74%/77.49%（联邦式）的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有HAR多模态融合方法通常对所有传感器流赋予固定相等权重，忽略了模态重要性、采集成本和传感器质量（因运动、错位或遮挡而变化）的差异，导致在动态真实环境中识别性能下降。同时，集中式训练在医疗等隐私敏感场景中存在数据安全风险。
AI.method: 1. 集中式框架MAPPO-MoE：将多模态融合建模为合作型MARL问题，每个模态分配一个PPO智能体，基于共享状态输出融合权重，奖励函数包含精度增益和归一化传感器成本两项；模态专用1D CNN编码器+MLP专家网络+Beta策略输出。2. 联邦扩展FedMHAR/BiFL-PPO：服务器端PPO智能体基于客户端验证准确率、损失、梯度范数等状态学习Beta分布信任权重，先验+学习权重混合后用于聚合（双向反馈至客户端调整学习率和近端正则化），采用反事实聚合的批量级密集奖励，每3轮进行一次PPO更新。
AI.result: 集中式MAPPO-MoE在MEx和UTD-MHAD上分别达到87.30%±2.53%和94.98%±0.88%，分别超越等权基线MoE约2-12个百分点，并优于LSTM-CNN、MhaGNN、TCN-Inception等SOTA方法；联邦FedMHAR在非IID（Dirichlet α=0.5）下达到79.74%和77.49%，稳定超越FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova、AdaFedProx（最大FedNova+8%），且标准差降低约5倍（更稳定）；BiFL-PPO可作为插件增强所有五种联邦基线方法。消融实验表明MAPPO在多模态场景（≥3模态）收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 将传感器与客户端信任建模为可学习的、上下文相关的决策（而非固定先验），能在两个数据集、两种学习范式（集中式/联邦）和五种联邦基线上持续提升准确率和训练稳定性，同时降低对昂贵传感器的依赖。RL驱动的信任分配是适用于多模态和联邦HAR系统的通用机制。未来工作包括：在传感器退化/损坏条件下评估成本感知能力，与更多RL-based联邦方法对比，以及在大规模客户端和通信轮次下验证。

title: RelaxKV: Recomputation Guided by the Query with Sparse Context Attention for Efficient KV Cache Reuse
summary: Cross-request KV caching reduces the prefill cost of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), but conventional prefix caching severely limits cache reuse across requests. Position-Independent Caching (PIC) removes this constraint by reusing independent chunks, but their KV states miss cross-chunk interactions. Existing methods selectively recompute token states to recover these missing interactions, but primarily allocate the recomputation budget to selecting which states to recompute, while fixing the recomputation context to the full causal prefix. We introduce RelaxKV, which formulates selective cache repair as a joint allocation problem over repair targets and recomputation context. Guided by the user query, RelaxKV identifies layer-specific repair targets and restricts their recomputation to a query-relevant context, reducing attention computation. Across four decoder models, RelaxKV at a 15% anchor ratio improves aggregate LongBench performance over ProphetKV on all models. On Qwen3-14B, RelaxKV provides a stronger quality-TTFT trade-off than ProphetKV across a 5%-30% anchor-ratio sweep, and achieves the best selective results on RULER-MV and LV-Eval at 16K and 32K context lengths. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the importance of recomputation context selection.

AI.tldr: RelaxKV提出了一种针对RAG场景中跨请求KV缓存复用的高效选择性缓存修复方法。它将选择性修复重新定义为修复目标(repair targets)和再压缩上下文(recomputation context)的联合分配问题。通过逐层查询注意力引导，选择层级特定的修复目标，并将其再压缩上下文限制在与查询相关的位置，从而同时减少状态计算量和注意力计算量。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）中跨请求KV缓存复用能显著降低预填充成本，但传统前缀缓存限制复用范围。位置无关缓存（PIC）虽放宽限制，却丢失了跨块交互。现有选择性修复方法（如CacheBlend、EPIC、KVShare、ProphetKV）只关注选择哪些状态重算，而固定使用完整因果前缀作为再压缩上下文，暴露出第二个设计维度——再压缩上下文选择——的缺失。
AI.method: RelaxKV的核心方法包括：(1) 逐层查询注意力评分：对查询与naive缓存运行注意力，按层独立归一化得分；(2) 逐层独立选择修复锚点(anchors)，每个token保留其最高被选层h_i；(3) 由所有层锚点的并集U构建共享再压缩上下文C_l(p)=U∩{j:j≤p}，实现因果掩码；(4) 仅活跃修复目标执行Transformer块，注意力仅作用于C_l(p)，KV状态为新计算与缓存的混合；(5) 通过RelaxKV_G对照实验验证上下文选择的重要性。
AI.result: 在四个解码模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-14B、Phi-4-14B、Llama-3.2-3B）上的实验表明：15%锚点比例下RelaxKV在LongBench上均优于ProphetKV；在Qwen3-14B上5%-30%锚点扫描中实现更优的质量-TTFT权衡；在RULER-MV 32K上达到95.00%准确率（ProphetKV为91.17%），LV-Eval 16K/32K上分别达28.71/25.40 F1，刷新选择性缓存修复方法的最佳水平。上下文构建消融实验表明，全局稀疏、层级稀疏与RelaxKV的锚点并集策略之间质量差异显著，验证了上下文构造本身是关键设计选择。
AI.conclusion: RelaxKV将选择性缓存修复从单一目标选择扩展为修复目标与再压缩上下文的联合分配，通过层级查询注意力引导实现层级特定的目标与共享查询相关上下文。在四个模型和多个长上下文基准上的竞争性质量-延迟权衡验证了该方法的有效性，尤其在长上下文场景中表现出色。匹配目标对照与上下文构建消融共同验证了再压缩上下文选择的重要性。

title: When Evidence Changes the Subject: Subject-Typed Claim Licensing for Learned Routing
summary: Modern learned systems increasingly combine learned components with search, repair, or external solvers. Benchmarks often measure the resulting end-to-end system, while scientific claims may concern only one component, creating an attribution problem: evidence can fail to support the requested component-level claim while still supporting a positive conclusion about the larger system. Existing evidence-to-claim methods primarily calibrate claim strength. We argue that composite systems require a second dimension: scientific subject. We address this problem with subject-typed claim licensing, which separates weaker conclusions about the requested subject from positive but non-substitutive credit about another subject. We instantiate this idea in SCOPE-Routing for preference-conditioned multigraph routing. Non-authors reproducibly apply the declared semantics; held-out review yields fewer reference-relative upward deviations than unstructured review, while the difference from a strong evidence checklist remains unresolved; and a controlled routing study shows that score-optimal and claim-eligible methods can differ while valid hybrid-system credit is preserved. These results motivate treating claim strength and scientific subject as distinct dimensions of evidence-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对复合学习系统中的科学归因问题，提出"主题类型化声明许可"（subject-typed claim licensing）框架，将声明强度（claim strength）与科学主题（scientific subject）作为证据评估的两个独立维度。在偏好条件多图路由任务上实例化为SCOPE-Routing，通过对象重构、评审判断和受控路由决策三项研究验证其可行性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代学习系统日益呈现组合性：学习组件与搜索、修复或外部求解器协同工作，端到端基准评估衡量的是完整系统的行为，而科学声明可能仅针对单一组件。当两个路由器获得相近的端到端遗憾值时，一个通过学习策略求解，另一个则依赖后备求解器——证据支持的声明主题不同，造成科学归因难题。现有证据-声明方法主要校准声明强度，无法区分"同一主题下较弱结论"与"不同主题下的正面结论"，导致系统级证据被错误归因于组件，或丢弃关于系统的正面证据。
AI.method: 核心方法为"主题类型化声明许可"语义。形式化定义为合同 𝒦=(𝒞,σ,⪯,Ω,𝒪,𝒜,ℬ,Π)，其中σ标识声明所属主题，个体化标记强度序，ℬ标记保留信用候选。关键创新在于：减弱仅在同一主题内进行（𝒞⋆），而ℛ⋆保留不可替代的跨主题正面信用，且ℬ中的元素与c_req不可比，禁止跨主题替代。实例化于SCOPE-Routing，针对偏好条件多图路由设计C0–C6学习主线声明链（C0标量决策质量→C6部署级支持），辅以混合系统、源原生、诊断三类保留信用族。评估分三阶段：（1）非作者重构与执行一致性（ClaimScope-120数据集，120条声明、4位盲注标注者）；（2）40条留出评审对比（细心评审 vs 证据清单 vs SCOPE-Routing，8位专家、240项判断）；（3）受控路由后果研究（RouteScope-Lite，1500请求、15个策略族、10个种子）。
AI.result: （1）非作者对象重构：24条声明中比较器23/24一致、主题族21/24一致、状态24/24在1级内一致；ClaimScope-120上4位标注者加权κ=0.703、Krippendorff α=0.686，SCOPE-Routing与人类多数投票101/120完全一致、115/120在1级内一致。（2）留出评审（36条专家解析声明）：SCOPE-Routing一致率31/36，参考相对上偏仅2/36（细心评审8/36、清单5/36），下偏4/36；相对细心评审一致率差异19.4百分点 [5.6, 33.3]，相对清单差异11.1百分点 [-2.8, 25.0]（区间跨零，差异未确定）。（3）RouteScope-Lite中：分数最优策略Fallback-Heavy Safe（遗憾0.011091，86.1%后备求解）不满足C5学习主线声明，保留混合系统可行性信用；而Shock-Safe Online Repair（遗憾0.016189）满足C5证据要求，被声明条件选择规则选中；分数排序与声明条件排序的Kendall τ_b=0.407。删一门槛消融显示各门槛对应不同虚假支持模式（后备、图塌缩、覆盖丧失、静态等价、隐藏延迟、源升级、解锁工件）。
AI.conclusion: 主题类型化声明许可将声明强度和科学主题作为基于证据评估的两个独立坐标。请求主题支持（𝒞⋆）回答"证据能对该主题说什么"，保留信用（ℛ⋆）记录"证据还正面支持什么"，两者通过非替代规则保持分离。三项研究表明：（a）非作者可重构并一致执行声明-证据对象；（b）共享声明语义改变了科学评审的操作点，减少上偏但增加保守性；（c）分数最优与目标声明合格的策略可不同，同时有效保留混合系统正面信用。该框架不估计跨主题归因在ML文献中的普遍性，半合成证据不构成部署证据；声明合同应被视作规范化、可版本化、可争议的科学对象，明示证据-结论关系而非隐式重建。未来需在更广泛任务采样、独立开发合同与运行数据上验证。

title: What Happens During Autonomous Deep Research After the User Steps Away?
summary: In autonomous deep research, a user provides a task and relevant background, then leaves the agent to conduct an extended investigation without further human intervention. We study how this initial user information is reflected in intermediate actions and how these actions relate to final recommendations. We introduce DRaligned, a counterfactual behavioral evaluation framework built on PDR-Bench. By varying one task-relevant user factor while keeping the remaining context fixed, we compare acquisition requests, working drafts, and final reports. Source-grounded extraction, blinded local judgments, and deterministic aggregation yield coarse directional measurements while leaving ambiguous cases unresolved. Our experiments show that strong user-specific delivery can emerge from a largely shared research process: agents investigate similar broad questions but allocate requests differently, and final recommendations distinguish user conditions more clearly than explicit requests do. Reports can also integrate user factors that were not jointly visible during acquisition. In readable draft-to-report comparisons, recommendations often retain their coarse user-specific direction despite substantial rewriting. Final directional differences recur across tested agent models, execution harnesses, and evaluator models, even as execution paths vary. These findings describe how initial user information shapes autonomous research and clarify the relationship between the process an agent follows and the recommendations it delivers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自治深度研究智能体在用户提供初始任务与背景信息后，无人干预下执行长期研究的过程。研究提出DRaligned框架，基于PDR-Bench构建反事实行为评估，通过改变单一任务相关用户因子，对比信息获取请求、工作草稿和最终报告中的方向性表现。核心发现：智能体可能采用大致相同的研究议程但产生用户特定的推荐，报告能整合未在请求中共同出现的用户因子，推荐方向在大幅重写中保持不变，且不同执行路径可达成相同方向结果。
AI.motivation: 自治深度研究场景中，用户在提供任务和背景信息后离开，智能体独立完成长时间跨度的研究。现有个性化研究主要关注对话式个性化或报告级质量评估，而缺乏对智能体在无交互执行期间如何将初始用户信息转化为具体行为，以及中间动作与最终推荐之间关系的系统性研究。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过反事实行为评估理解用户信息如何影响自治研究过程。
AI.method: DRaligned是一个基于PDR-Bench构建的反事实行为评估框架。针对每个任务构建仅在一个任务相关用户因子上不同的配对用户条件P和Q（保持其他背景固定），在相同的模型、harness配置下执行自治研究。观察三个功能观察通道：获取(Acquisition)、工作区(Workspace)和终结化(Finalization)。使用源链接提取、盲法局部判断、镜像端点展示和确定性聚合来识别行为是否表达某一端点、两者、两者皆非或保持不确定。Matrix记录各行为位点的方向状态，Flow描述同一运行内的有序状态转变。方向性读数采用镜像评估（两个评估读次交换端点顺序），仅当两次读取一致且有项目基础时才接受标签。通过五个智能体模型家族、五种执行harness、三种评估模型进行1,691次执行实验。
AI.result: 主要研究发现包括：(1) 强用户特定的交付可从大致共享的研究过程中产生——两个用户条件在363/390比较中访问相同的广义子问题，但请求分配差异在41/57可比子问题中超过重复运行的变异性；(2) 在110对主面板中，获取通道对比为D̂^A=0.15（95% CI [0.08, 0.24]），最终报告通道对比为D̂^F=0.83（[0.72, 0.92]），最终报告比显式请求更能区分用户条件；(3) 当d^A=0时，59.6%的对有可读最终比较，其中96.4%按分配方向分离；(4) 最终报告可整合未在请求中共同表达的用户因子——0/266请求表达两个分配因子，但25/29可读最终报告同时表达两者；(5) 84/86运行在最后一次检索后才保存首个草稿；(6) 在41个可读且文本不同的草稿到最终比较中，39个保持分配方向，38个保持"Own"状态；(7) 跨智能体模型家族、推理设置、harness和评估模型，方向性差异持续存在；(8) 人类审计恢复率方面，在13项探索性研究中主要评审者匹配所有4个被接受的工具标签(4/4 each)。
AI.conclusion: 该研究区分了用户影响与报告质量本身，并澄清了智能体遵循的过程与其交付推荐之间的关系。研究表明自治深度研究中的用户控制是一种方向性、因子特定的现象，而非全局开关。请求不表达用户优先级并不等同于遗忘或独立；推荐可在大幅重写中保持其粗粒度方向；不同的可观察执行路径可在测试设置中达到相同的方向结果。未来的工作将在更细粒度上衡量推荐强度、约束满足度和实质性偏离，并进行独立验证，同时需要扩展任务、用户档案、模型路由和共享检索后端的覆盖面以增强泛化性。

title: PPG-LM: A Photoplethysmography-Language Model with Multi-Level Clinical Alignment
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely recorded by clinical monitors and consumer wearables, providing a scalable source of continuous physiological information. These recordings offer an opportunity for physiological assessment at scale, but realizing this potential requires models to learn from both signal-derived physiological supervision and broader clinical context captured in electronic health records (EHRs). This involves aligning information spanning local observations, care events, and entire visits with PPG representations at corresponding temporal scales. However, existing PPG foundation models primarily rely on task-specific prediction heads, while the medical knowledge of large language models does not necessarily translate into waveform understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce PPG-LM, the first PPG-language model family to learn physiological representations from both signal-derived supervision and broader clinical context captured in EHRs. To construct clinically grounded captions, we develop an automatic captioning pipeline that generates segment-, event-, and visit-level descriptions from signal measurements and structured EHR records. We then learn from these pairs through a two-stage framework that first establishes segment-language correspondence through contrastive learning and waveform-conditioned captioning, then extends alignment to events and visits through time-aware aggregation and temporal statement matching. Pretrained on approximately 73k hours of PPG, PPG-LM supports language-based recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and segment captioning. Experiments on MC-MED, MIMIC-III, and VitalDB show improved retrieval and caption factuality over language-model baselines and gains over PPG and time-series foundation models on multiple clinical prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: PPG-LM是首个将光电容积脉搏波（PPG）信号与多层级临床语言对齐的多模态基础模型系列，通过两阶段训练框架同时学习波形生理特征与EHR临床上下文，在识别、检索、描述及临床预测任务上均优于现有PPG基础模型和通用大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有PPG基础模型主要依赖任务特定预测头，缺乏波形-语言对齐能力；而大语言模型的医学知识无法直接迁移到脉搏波形态理解。该研究旨在弥合这一差距，将PPG信号与电子健康记录中的临床上下文进行多层级对齐。
AI.method: 1) 自动描述生成管道：从信号测量值和结构化EHR记录生成片段级（30秒窗口的生理特征）、事件级（用药事件前后上下文）和就诊级（人口统计学、病史、用药）描述。2) 两阶段对齐框架：阶段1通过对比学习和波形条件描述生成建立片段-语言对应；阶段2通过带符号时间偏移的注意力聚合扩展到事件级，通过8个参考时间的潜在查询聚合（含RoPE连续时间编码）扩展到就诊级，并采用ColBERT式后期交互进行时序语句匹配。3) 蒸馏正则化（λ=0.1）保留阶段1学习的片段对齐。预训练于约73,700小时PPG数据（MC-MED）。
AI.result: 在MC-MED、MIMIC-III、VitalDB三数据集上：零样本生理识别在11项中10项取得最佳（Macro-F1）；跨模态检索MC-MED S2T/T2S R@1达0.975/0.965；描述事实准确性达0.923/0.920/0.820；32项临床预测任务中在30项上优于所有6个基础模型基线（PaPaGei-S、Pulse-PPG、AnyPPG、SIGMA-PPG、MOMENT-L、Chronos-2）。
AI.conclusion: PPG-LM成功建立了PPG与临床语言的多层级对齐，证明了共享波形和文本编码器结合信号+EHR双重监督的有效性，特征可在不同临床环境（急诊、ICU、手术室）间迁移，但仍需多中心验证和前瞻性临床评估。

title: EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research
summary: Self-evolving agents aim to turn research feedback into reusable skills, tools, and research rules. Whether these accumulated capabilities continue to improve later research requires controlled evaluation. Long-horizon alpha discovery provides a state-dependent setting: once a new factor enters the portfolio, the predictive information already covered changes, so the value of the same candidate or experience may change over time. We introduce EverMine, an empirical framework for studying self-evolving research capabilities in long-horizon alpha discovery. EverMine decomposes the research state into history (Hist), the current factor portfolio (Frontier), and reusable capabilities (Cap). Under matched resource limits, we compare complete runs with fixed or evolving Cap, and replace Cap while holding Hist and Frontier fixed to estimate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities. We also combine full trajectories with historical-state replay to examine how experience-based decisions affect candidate selection and portfolio outcomes. Across 18 long-horizon trajectories, end-to-end comparisons show no consistent gain from Cap evolution. Across 48 continuation branches from shared Hist and Frontier states, accumulated Cap also does not consistently outperform the initial Cap. Parameter tuning of existing factor structures can still improve the portfolio. In an exploratory replay of two screening batches from one Evolving trajectory, some screened-out candidates have positive marginal value at the original state, yet submitting all screened-out candidates sequentially slightly lowers final portfolio IC in both batches. These results show that candidate value depends on the evolving portfolio and submission order, and motivate evaluating self-evolving research capabilities through end-to-end outcomes, conditional capability value, and the consequences of experience-based decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EverMine 框架，研究在长周期 alpha 挖掘中，自演化智能体所积累的可复用研究能力（Cap）是否真正能持续改善后续研究。通过将研究状态分解为历史（Hist）、当前因子组合（Frontier）和可复用能力（Cap），并在 18 条长周期轨迹和 48 条分支上进行端到端对比与能力替换实验，发现显式的 Cap 演化并未带来一致的增益，但参数调优仍能贡献正向收益，且经验驱动的筛选会同时遗漏具有正边际价值的候选。
AI.motivation: 在长周期 alpha 挖掘场景中，因子组合持续演化，候选因子的价值高度依赖于当前组合的状态。自演化智能体虽然能够将反馈累积为可复用的技能、工具和研究规则，但这些显式累积的能力能否在后续研究中持续带来增益，缺乏受控评估。已有工作多在最终端点比较，混淆了历史、组合与能力三者的共同影响，难以单独衡量 Cap 的条件价值。
AI.method: EverMine 将研究状态显式分解为 Hist（研究历史）、Frontier（当前因子组合）和 Cap（可复用能力）三部分。在资源对齐条件下比较 Fixed（Cap 固定）与 Evolving（Cap 可演化）两组的端到端表现；并在共享 Hist 和 Frontier 的检查点上进行 Cap 状态替换，以估计累积 Cap 对后续研究的后续价值。此外结合完整轨迹统计与历史状态回放，分析参数调优贡献以及经验筛选对候选选择与组合结果的影响。
AI.result: 在 18 条长周期轨迹上，端到端比较显示 Cap 演化未带来一致增益；在 48 条共享起点的 Cap 替换分支中，累积 Cap 同样未持续优于初始 Cap，所有差异区间均包含零。行为分析表明，在 18 条轨迹中有 16 条的参数调优对组合 IC 有正向贡献；但对两批筛选批次的回放显示，经验筛选虽能保留高价值候选，却遗漏了部分具有正边际价值的候选，而将全部被筛掉因子顺序提交后，最终组合 IC 在两批中均略有下降（-0.0175 和 -0.0067）。
AI.conclusion: 显式累积的可复用研究能力在长周期 alpha 挖掘中并未表现出持续的增益；候选因子的价值依赖于演化中的组合和提交顺序。研究能力的评估应从三个互补视角展开：端到端研究产出、累积能力的条件价值，以及基于经验的研究决策所带来的实际后果。未来的能力设计与评估应更直接地将已记录的经验与实际使用和组合反馈相连接。

title: Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models
summary: Looped reasoners spend test-time compute by iterating a weight-tied map, but a small residual does not mean the state is a fixed point when that map lives in unconstrained latent space. We propose Geometric Fixed-Point Reasoning (GFPR), in which the iterated state is the prediction itself: a field of categorical beliefs on a product of simplices, whose argmax is the answer at every step. Because the state is a belief, task structure can be imposed through compact convex relaxations, either as structured readouts or directly in the recurrent state; in the latter case the update remains a continuous self-map, so a fixed point exists for any parameters. At about 7M parameters, GFPR reaches 95.1% exact match on Sudoku-Extreme, 92.0% on Maze-Hard, and 100% sequence accuracy on S_5 length 128, above the published FPRM numbers at the same scale. The same update also trains a 201M language model on FineWeb-Edu in which each site is a distribution over the vocabulary; with 24 Picard steps it is above GPT-2 small on four zero-shot multiple-choice tasks and above GPT-2 medium on ARC-Easy.

AI.tldr: GFPR（几何不动点推理）提出了一种循环推理器，其状态本身即为预测值——在单纯形乘积上的分类信念场。通过Brouwer不动点定理保证任意参数下不动点的存在性，并在数独、迷宫、置换群跟踪及语言建模任务上超越同类规模方法。
AI.motivation: 现有循环推理器（如FPRM、TRM、HRM）在无约束潜空间中迭代权重共享映射，小残差并不等于到达不动点。论文指出FPRM在公共Sudoku检查点上停止时并非真正的不动点（局部放大探针显示主特征值|λ|≈1.04），需要更坚实的存在性保证与可解释的中间状态。
AI.method: 将状态定义为单纯形乘积上的分类信念场（每个位置是K个输出符号加A个辅助坐标的概率向量），通过带阻尼的Picard迭代更新：softmax后用Π_x将已知线索钉为one-hot。状态本身即预测（argmax即可读取答案），残差直接衡量答案移动量。利用Brouwer定理保证紧凸集上的连续自映射必有不动点。任务结构通过紧凸松弛施加：数独的一致性多面体、迷宫的单位流多面体、S5的双随机矩阵（Birkhoff多面体），使用Fenchel-Young损失训练。语言模型引入wavefront解码（前缘提交+软前瞻窗口）以适配因果注意力下的迭代生成。
AI.result: 约7M参数下：Sudoku-Extreme达95.1%精确匹配（单轨迹，FPRM为94.2%），Maze-Hard达92.0%（FPRM为87.0%），S5长度128序列准确率100%（FPRM为98.8%）。加入凸约束后Maze-Hard提升至96.0%。201M语言模型（FineWeb-Edu，6B token）24步Picard迭代后在ARC-Easy等四个零样本多选任务上超过GPT-2 small，并在ARC-Easy上超过GPT-2 medium。迭代动力学分析显示GFPR在float64精度下收敛到不动点（最大Ritz模≈1.3×10⁻³），而FPRM停止状态并非不动点。
AI.conclusion: 循环推理器应迭代其预测而非潜码。GFPR的信念场状态在每一步均可读取为答案，残差直接衡量答案稳定性，紧凸设计保证不动点存在性。在Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard、S5上超越同规模公开单轨迹方法；同一更新机制在词汇表上训练出可工作的语言模型，质量来自迭代。局限：基线为引用而非重训，无法隔离状态空间的独立贡献；语言模型对比未做计算匹配且评估的是似然而非生成；少数数独谜题收敛到稳定但错误的解，可通过约束违反度选择重启作为下一步工作。

title: OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning
summary: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSCC（观察安全反事实耦合）框架，针对不完全信息博弈中配对rollout的两大问题——耦合可能泄露隐藏状态/同步内生策略随机性，以及多动作策略优化中单纯降低回报对比方差并非真正目标——设计了包含边际保持、信息状态安全、策略随机分支本地化、语义事件对齐、轨迹先于oracle回放五大约束的可接受耦合类。推导出梯度感知耦合准则（多动作下策略梯度噪声由策略Jacobian加权的非对角回报协方差决定），并提出OSCC-Select校准选择器在独立/仅根/仅延续/全耦合四种rollout间基于安全证书与增益证书自动切换，配合Hoeffding有限样本安全回退保证。实验在10万组固定根Leduc对比中实现回报对比方差降低55.87%（41.1158→18.1441），三动作场景下梯度噪声迹0.0783优于方差选择法的0.0917，校准组数从64增至2048使认证率从0.327升至0.995。
AI.motivation: 不完全信息博弈（如扑克）中，反事实动作比较的rollout噪声很大，而标准共随机数（CRN）配对存在两类根本缺陷：(1) 隐藏状态可能被泄露、内生策略随机性被错误同步、或在历史分叉后机会事件错位；(2) 在多动作策略优化中，最小化回报对比的标量方差并不等价于最小化策略梯度噪声，真正相关的是经过局部策略梯度几何投影后的回报协方差矩阵。因此需要一个形式化的可接受耦合类与自适应的耦合选择机制。
AI.method: OSCC形式化为约束耦合问题，定义五大约束条件（C1–C5）：边际保持（C1）、信息状态安全排除对手私有牌/终端oracle/C2）、策略随机分支本地化（C3）、语义事件对齐与轨迹先冻结（C4–C5）。RNG命名空间分离环境键（允许共享隐藏状态）与策略键（排除隐藏字段）。关键理论结果包括：命题2的全协方差分解（根复用 vs 延续共享两源）、命题3的梯度感知耦合差（多动作下差异由⟨g_i,g_j⟩加权协方差差决定，二动作退化为对比方差）、定理1的Hoeffding有限样本安全回退保证。OSCC-Select在四类rollout间基于J_λ(Γ,z)=E[N(Γ;I)]+λ·C(Γ,z)目标，用同时下置信界证书选择，可校准冻结后回退到独立采样。CP-GRPO是全耦合实例化，保持PPO/GRPO优化目标不变，仅修改rollout构造。
AI.result: 主要审计：10万组固定根Leduc对比，CP-GRPO配对方差18.1441 vs 独立41.1158，降低55.87%；check-bet协方差+11.18 vs -0.115；100000/100000组有效，方差恒等残差<10^-12；边际等价检验在ε=0.05下通过。2×2因子分解：仅延续25.43、仅根32.76、全耦合18.33 vs 独立41.09。三动作场景：OSCC-Select选仅延续耦合，梯度噪声迹0.0783 vs 方差选择法0.0917（Oracle 0.0778）。校准样本：64组时认证率0.327、误选率0.031；2048组时0.995/0.001，遗憾0.0009。策略端点（5种子Leduc测试）：CP-GRPO回报0.2847±0.0196、独立0.2369±0.0284；exploitability 0.1184 vs 0.1715；CFR+参考0.0152。跨环境迁移：Leduc训练在Kuhn密封测试上达到方差比0.4996、exploitability 0.0109 vs PPO 0.0211。安全证书对5类受控信息边界违规全部拒绝（512/512）。三种子有界更新诊断独立采样诊断exploitability更低（-0.0207、-0.0704、-0.0709），揭示降噪与最终策略质量不完全等价。
AI.conclusion: OSCC为不完全信息学习提供了可操作的耦合契约，将古典CRN协方差恒等式转化为带信息状态安全保证的策略梯度噪声控制工具。梯度感知准则澄清了多动作场景下标量方差误导选择的问题，同时下置信界证书使自适应选择具备有限样本保证。CP-GRPO作为全耦合实例在固定根估计器层面显著降低对比方差并改善下游策略与求解器端点，但有界更新诊断同时表明单纯降噪不一定带来更好最终策略——这界定了方法的适用边界。代码、配置哈希、回放清单与hash绑定充分统计量随补充材料发布以支持复现。

title: Dr. Free: You Don't Need Difficulty Rewards for Self-Evolving Search Agents
summary: A central limitation of current data-free self-evolution methods for training search agents is their reliance on difficulty-based proposer rewards. These methods reward a proposer for generating questions that challenge a co-evolving solver, using solver difficulty as a proxy for question quality. Yet difficulty alone is insufficient to distinguish questions that require cross-passage evidence from those that are answerable via simpler shortcuts. In addition, measuring difficulty demands repeated solver rollouts for every candidate question, leading to substantial computational costs. In this paper, we introduce \methodname, the first self-evolving search framework that eliminates difficulty-based proposer rewards and directly optimizes for evidence necessity relative to shortcut contexts. Dr. Free samples relational chains from a knowledge graph and pairs them with aligned passages, giving question generation an explicit multi-hop structure. A generated question receives a positive information-gain reward only when the likelihood of the target answer under the complete evidence passages exceeds the maximum likelihood under all evaluated shortcut contexts. Because this signal is computed from teacher-forced likelihoods, it removes the need for pass-rate estimation and reduces proposer training time by over $7\times$. Experiments on seven open-domain QA benchmarks show that Dr. Free outperforms prior data-free search agents and the supervised baseline, with large improvements on multi-hop QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Dr. Free是首个无需难度奖励的无数据自演化搜索智能体框架。它通过知识图谱关系链进行结构化多跳问题构造，并采用基于信息增益的捷径感知奖励替代求解器难度信号，在多跳QA基准上显著优于Dr. Zero，同时将提议器训练时间减少超过7倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的无数据自演化方法依赖基于求解器难度的提议器奖励，但难度无法区分真正需要跨段落证据的问题与可走捷径回答的问题，且估计难度需要大量计算开销。研究还发现Dr. Zero等方法存在严重的"伪多跳"退化：超过80%的多跳标签问题实际上未执行搜索，目标答案直接出现在种子段落中。
AI.method: Dr. Free包含两个核心组件：(1) 知识图谱链采样器：从Wikidata5M采样关系链并与Wiki-18段落对齐，通过去环、功能性关系过滤和两阶段检索验证构造显式多跳证据结构；(2) 捷径感知信息增益奖励：使用冻结锚点模型，通过比较完整证据下与多种捷径上下文（闭卷、仅源段落、单次检索、各跳段落）下目标答案的teacher-forced似然差来评分问题质量，无需求解器rollout。提议器使用HRPO优化，求解器使用GRPO训练，二者交替进行3轮自演化迭代。
AI.result: 在7个开放域QA基准上，Dr. Free在5个骨干模型上一致优于Dr. Zero及监督基线Search-R1。多跳QA提升尤为显著：在3B模型上多跳基准平均EM提升1.7-9.5分，提议器训练时间加速7.37×-9.61×。消融实验证实移除KG结构或IG奖励均导致性能下降。金盲反事实审计显示Dr. Free将所有4种捷径率降至2%-5%，显著低于Dr. Zero（17%-88%）。训练-测试重叠分析排除数据泄漏可能（仅0.048%相似问题）。
AI.conclusion: Dr. Free提出了一种原理性且实用的方法，通过将提议器优化从求解器相对难度转向基于显式捷径比较的证据依赖性度量，生成更高质量的训练问题，同时提高了无数据搜索智能体自演化的有效性和效率。

title: OpenFC: Learning Verification Policies towards Open-Search Fact Checking
summary: Open-search fact checking is not merely retrieval followed by classification, but a sequential decision problem in which every query, source visit, and stopping decision reshapes the evidence available for verification. Yet existing systems often distribute these decisions across predefined pipelines or separately prompted modules rather than learning them as a unified task-specific policy. We introduce \textbf{OpenFC}, a unified verification-policy training framework that post-trains Qwen3-8B as a compact next-action controller over reasoning, evidence acquisition, and stopping. OpenFC learns this policy in two stages. \textbf{Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start (SCCS)} uses a strong training-time supervisor to review post-initial reasoning, tool-use, and stopping proposals before execution, producing reliable trajectories for supervised fine-tuning without access to gold verdicts. \textbf{Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning (VA-RL)} then improves the cold-start policy on unresolved claims through budget-aware tool rewards, label-aware advantage reweighting, and localized response masking.
